desc: A road for pilgrims. Long ago, pilgrims passed through here to pray to the gods. Ironically, you're taking this road in order to defeat a god.

name: Unforgiving Light
desc: The end of the road is near. A strong power can be felt coming from it. The enemy lurking there will most likely be your last obstacle here.

name: The Lifeless Snake
desc: You are overwhelmed by the gigantic stature of the castle-like Afla Dilith. However, everyone is counting on you, so there's no time to waste.

name: Crawling Toward Death
desc: There are still many enemies left on the way to the castle. Surely Karl and the others will have to face even more of them as you move on ahead.

name: The Putrid Tome
desc: The sound of your allies fighting behind you grows louder. Head towards the castle while everyone else draws the enemies' attention.

name: Heaps of Corpses
desc: The enemies in your path continue getting stronger. It can only mean that your last target is drawing near. The castle's gates should be just ahead.

name: The Final Hour
desc: The castle is within a stone's throw, and the god's powerful presence grows stronger. However, it's no time to buckle under pressure. Step inside.

name: Fighting Death
desc: You can see the last hoard of enemies in front of the gate. If you can get past them, you will finally be inside Afla Dilith!

name: Ends & Beginnings
desc: Tilith, Karl, everyone... You're worried about the friends you left behind fighting. However, there's no turning back now. You must press forward.

name: Heaven & Earth Divide
desc: Looking inside the castle, nothing really seems out of place. Although without Tilith's protective barrier, you might have fallen prey to Afla Dilith.

name: Turning the Tide
desc: You can hear Tilith fighting from the entrance. Inspired by her courage, your feet rush forward at full speed!

name: Rejecting Sublation
desc: As you proceed further in, the sounds of battle coming from the entrance disappear. You can still feel Tilith's barrier protecting you, though.

name: Universal Equality
desc: You've made your way through a big portion of the fortress. Past this corridor lies its center. The real body of the Fallen God is probably there.

name: Back to the Roots
desc: You exit into a room enveloped in tree roots. The next step should lead you to the heart of the castle, but a dark hero blocks your path.

name: The God of Truth
desc: The time for the real final fight with the last Fallen God, the Beast God Afla Dilith, has come... Defeat him and return to your friends!

name: Song from the Seabed
desc: After visiting the temple a second time, you think you hear the voice of a young girl singing. Her song made the rough waves vanish like the sea foam.

name: Blazing Transgression
desc: A hair raising howling can be heard. It looks like many monsters seem to inhabit this town, so there seems to be no easy escape from here.

name: Cursed Singing Voice
desc: A beautiful singing voice lingers in the air. Could this be the work of a demon as well? And why have so many monsters gathered in this ghost town?

name: Idle Gossip
desc: How strange. No matter how much you advance, you keep finding yourself back where you started. It's like being in the fairies' grove all over again.

name: Within the Commotion
desc: There are too many enemies. What could've led them here? As you think that to yourself, a piercing and thunderous sound resonates around you.

name: Meeting the Maidens
desc: The neigh of a Pegasus reaches your ears, a pure sound ill-fitted for this ghost town. A battle with the maidens awaits ahead.

name: Night Draws Near
desc: You can feel many more enemies obstructing your way now. If you're lucky enough, defeating the last hoard of them might be your ticket out of here.

name: Vast Sea of Sand
desc: You can see a vast desert in front of you. There seems to be no end to it, but you must take this cruel path in order to move forward.

name: Great Desert Path
desc: You confirm the sun's location to avoid losing your way. Short on patience and with your body almost boiling, beads of sweat fall from your forehead.

name: The Sword & Axe Dance
desc: A cloud of sand starts covering your clothes. You swallow the fine pieces of sand the wind picks up as you breathe. Deserts are still not your forte.

name: Rising Heat Shimmer
desc: As the sunshine gets hotter, heat haze begins to rise from beneath. Beyond the shaky mirage in front of you, you spy the creeping shadow of the enemy.

name: Before the Sandstorm
desc: A cloudless, blue firmament above, and scorching, yellow sand beneath. As you look behind you, everything grows darker. A sandstorm is on its way.

name: Crossing the River
desc: After leaving the great the desert behind, you come across a river so big that the shore seems invisible. It will take a lot of effort to cross it.

name: The Deep Riverbed
desc: At times, the river fish jump high up. Surprised by the sound, you finally see the enemy closing in. You realize now the fish were trying to warn you.

name: Glistening Riverside
desc: Halfway up the river you hear a creaking noise and see that the surface of the river has begun to freeze. It seems the enemy is here.

name: In Order to Flow
desc: As you admire the grandeur of this river, you reminisce of battle. Even though you have defeated the Four Fallen Gods, other battles still lie ahead.

name: Surging Bay Breeze
desc: A strong wind blows. The water's surface ripples, and then crashes in a big splash. It may be a sign of the road up ahead, which makes you nervous.

name: Endless Foliage
desc: As you walk through the thick forest, you get lost. The path to a free future... You'll have to make your own way to get there.

name: The Forest's Fountain
desc: You arrive at a place in the forest where a small spring bubbles. You consider taking a rest, but enemies start appearing one by one. Break's over.

name: Godspeed Gale
desc: A strong wind blows in the forest. As the leaves brush upon each other they sound like the waves of the ocean. It's a sea of trees indeed.

name: Budding Earth
desc: Breeze blows strongly through the trees, picking up old leaves, and fluttering new ones. This is the force that transforms the forest anew.

name: Boisterous Trees
desc: The sea of trees sways as the wind hits it. One could say that even these living beings feel anxious about the future fate of the world.

name: A Painful Climb
desc: The rough, shiny rock around shows traces of lightning. It seems it has been absorbing it during the endless storms. Pressing forward won't be easy.

name: Watcher at the Summit
desc: As you climb an electrified cliff, you pass peaks as sharp as needles. You can't help but feel like this road is a premonition of the future to come.

name: Dark Clouds Await
desc: The thunder and lightning that falls here is absorbed by the mountain. It has accumulated so much after the years that it might burst any minute now.

name: Higher than the Sky
desc: You've reached the Mt. Granakia's highest peak, where you can see the whole of Atharva. You see a giant castle in the distance. Is that Eriole's base?

name: Wind Blows to Heaven
desc: You can see Paris at the bottom of the cliff. It seems she followed you here. You were told to talk to her, but what exactly do you have in mind?

name: The Garden of Life
desc: After climbing over the mountain, you reach a beautiful garden. However, no people seem to come here, so how has it been kept so well maintained?

name: Flowers Bloom Proudly
desc: Beautiful flower beds are arranged next to each other in the garden. These amazing flowers couldn't have bloomed without lots of care, and yet...

name: Pursuing Wisdom
desc: You can see a fountain amidst the flower beds. The water sparkles as it flows from a beautifully carved pedestal. What a great spectacle to behold.

name: Revering the Heavens
desc: Small birds flutter about, chirping a song. One flees suddenly, and when you follow it with your eyes, you see a great shadow dropping from the sky...

name: Instrumental Trio
desc: The floral aroma, the chirping of the birds, and the beauty of the trimmed hedges... Looking at it now, this is a beautiful, if not perfect, garden.

name: Demanding Justice
desc: Could this garden have been made by human hands? How could it have remained so beautiful without any people left to care for it?

name: Wind of Beginnings
desc: Small flowers sway in the wind, butterflies flutter about, and the birds fly high in the sky. A wind of new beginnings is leaving the old age behind.

name: Where Souls Sleep
desc: Having passed the gorgeous garden, you reach a gloomy cemetery. Among the expressionless tombstones standing, a voice calls from within the silence.

name: Graveyard Banquet
desc: Tesla said Paris was useless to them now. If Eriole truly feels that way, then just what could he be after...?

name: A Soldier's Tombstone
desc: This part of the cemetery seems to be dedicated to soldiers fallen in battle. You can see that their tombstones have a sword symbol carved onto them.

name: Funeral Candles
desc: If a civil war breaks in Elgaia, many lives will be lost. This must be prevented at all costs.

name: Carved Slab
desc: Reading the few words you can make out from the headstones, you gather that this was once one of the most important places in Atharva.

name: Dangerous Territory
desc: You feel something cold run down your spine. Feeling an evil presence, you look around you. Darkness is closing in, the enemy's coming!

name: Winding Down
desc: Not even the wind seems to reach this place, and your movements start to feel sluggish. The smell of moss and mold lingers in the air.

name: To the Shiny Palace
desc: The spark of battle has been ignited. Defeat the enemies standing in your way, and head towards the depths of Eriole's castle!

name: Gate to a New Era
desc: A cold steel blade strikes at you, and fiery claws rush towards you. No matter who the enemy may be, you must not falter!

name: Garden of Truth
desc: A fist cracks the floor open, and a lance tries to pierce you as you counterattack. Strong enemies have gathered here, but you must press on!

name: The Sage & the Hero
desc: Lightning flashes in the hall, and a sword that seems to block darkness shimmers brightly. If you want to stop the revolution, focus on the enemy now!

name: Establishing Order
desc: Light pierces the walls, and countless arrows begin to rain down. The enemy is strong, but you still have morale. Hurry and make your way through!

name: Thriving Cornerstone
desc: Dual blades dance in the air, and one strike from a hefty lance breaks the floor open. Just a bit more till you face Eriole deep in the castle.

name: Unification Pillar
desc: The shadow overhead is just as strong as the light. The world is being distorted, probably tearing at the seams. You're just steps away from Eriole!

name: Changing the World
desc: Eriole's ideas are warped. The idea that a bloody revolution can bring about a peaceful future cannot possibly be true. He must be stopped.

name: Crucible of Confusion
desc: You discover a cave dispersing an ominous miasma. There are traces of a strong seal at the entrance, but you seem to be able to come and go freely.

name: The Dragons' Welcome
desc: As you approach the heart of the gloomy forest, you think you hear the cry of the ancient dragon rumored to be sealed within it.

name: Chanting Spirits
desc: After fighting away the dragons, you hear the voices of the deceased singing around you. It looks like the creatures of this forest mean to stop you.

name: Dance of the Pixies
desc: You get the eerie feeling that someone's watching you. Could it be Ark? No, this stare is from the beings dwelling in the forest.

name: The Birds' Invitation
desc: The dim forest is full of silence. The moment you think your ears have grown accustomed to it, a flock of birds suddenly lets out a shrilling cry.

name: Fighting Goddesses
desc: After the flock of birds has gone, you encounter a group of fighting goddesses. They study you as if trying to gauge your power.

name: The Demons' Feast
desc: You're almost out of the forest. You want to meet Tilith as soon as possible to talk to her, but the demonic miasma around you refuses to allow it.

name: Flickering Heat Haze
desc: The combination of Seria's excessively threatening attitude and all your memories of Tilith leave you in silence. You best follow the Goddess anyway.

name: Blazing Sand Quake
desc: The heat haze rising from the sand is as hot as fire itself. It even makes you wonder whether it is actually aflame.

name: Quelling Supreme Fire
desc: It is only normal to feel hot in a desert, but you've never felt this degree of heat before. It's a premonition of the enemies who want to stop you.

name: Roaring Flames
desc: The scorching desert is draining your energy. It doesn't seem like Tilith will appear here, but if you meet her again, you should try talking to her.

name: Plea of the Goddess
desc: You feel a presence. There's no doubt that Tilith is near. You want to avoid a fight with her, but how will it all turn out...?

name: Great Scarlet Stream
desc: A red river flows ahead. It reminds you of a red forest from your previous exploits. Just like during those hard times, Tilith is still by your side.

name: Red Waves
desc: What could be awaiting you? You are not completely sure, but watching the crimson waves makes you all the more uneasy.

name: Frozen Faith
desc: The red splash is freezing. You have now seen this omen of the strong opponents ahead a number of times. Beware of your surroundings and get ready.

name: Flowing Crimson Tide
desc: The red current looks just like blood. If humans were to be destroyed once again, the landscape would probably resemble an image like this one.

name: Water's Reflection
desc: The reflection of the light on the water makes the river sparkle. Its color made you uncomfortable before, but it may make for a beautiful view now.

name: Wreckage-Born Plains
desc: You have arrived at a ghost town. It was probably a normal village before it was destroyed. Thick grass grows along the remnants of the streets.

name: Bearing Ancient Times
desc: You were only worried about were stepped, but now you've noticed a gigantic tower in the distance. It must be the so-called Tower of the Oracle.

name: Verdant Ruin's Fate
desc: The greenery around you has grown louder. It could all be in your head, but is it possible that the insects are trying to warn you? The enemy's here!

name: Nature's Breath
desc: Humans don't fully understand the concept of a god yet. However, looking at Tilith you can't help but to feel there's not much of a difference.

name: Embraced by the Ruins
desc: In the outskirts of the village lies a small shrine. As you go past it, you lay your eyes upon the tower standing ahead. Ark awaits you.

name: The Gigantic Tower
desc: What could Ark's real motives be? Why is he attempting to test the Summoners' power? Or could he be trying to end it all here?

name: Seeking the Oracle
desc: The enemy is strong. However, you won't just stop fighting. Your ability to stop the Four Fallen Gods was no hoax, but Ark is well aware of that.

name: Pompous Thunder King
desc: Thunder clouds roar within the walls of the tower. Did you set off a trap, or could this be the enemy's power? Either way, you must push through.

name: Traitors of Humanity
desc: You're close to the top of the tower. As you continue forth, you feel a strong presence. Could the beings Ark mentioned be waiting ahead?

name: Twilight of Heroes
desc: What could have those enemies been? Many seemed to have been related to Ark somehow. That must mean that the next enemy is...

name: Control Gate
desc: Ark's words had a strong impact. What does Lucius plan to do with humanity now? There's no choice but to seek him and ask him directly.

name: The Glory of Victory
desc: When Ark removed his mask, his determination was written all over his face. Will you be able to hear any more important information from him again?

name: Ability to Rule
desc: Tilith seems completely at a loss about what Ark said regarding Lucius. It seems even she doesn't know everything about her master.

name: Fire of Knowledge
desc: A tension in the air is putting everything on edge. Is this the wrath of the heroes? Ark's figure is slowly becoming visible.

name: Divine Sword's Anger
desc: The curse of Karna Masta... Summoning was believed to be a power granted by Lucius, but things seem more complicated than that.

name: Radiance of Wisdom
desc: The history left behind is only a small portion of the history that has actually taken place. What new knowledge could be awaiting in the future?

name: Foundation of Dignity
desc: Tilith said she became Lucius's disciple after the great war with the gods. There may be even more things Tilith doesn't know than initially thought.

name: Reverence of Darkness
desc: It seems a fight against Lucius is imminent now. If only you could convince Tilith otherwise...

name: Suspended in the Dark
desc: This place is said to have been where people received divine commands from the gods. It must be a special place for the Oracle Knight Ark.

name: Power and Shadows
desc: The rocks' tough exterior seems to want to keep people away, but it may be testing if you have enough strength to finish the dreaded climb.

name: Faint Tremors
desc: How many moons have passed since this mountain lost its original purpose? The darkness that lingers in these mountain paths is quite dense.

name: Black Knight Advances
desc: A shadow lurks in the ridge below. This figure clad in jet black armor is perhaps the lone knight the Six Heroes mentioned. It's time for battle.

name: Suppressing Evil
desc: As you make your climb down the steep cliff, demons come after you. Only a little bit more until you reach the Grand Gaia Crater where Lucius awaits.

name: Before the Dawn
desc: If only Lucius would reconsider his decision of destroying humanity, a battle could be avoided... Is this mentality perhaps too idealistic?

name: The Seal has Broken
desc: The battle has finally begun. Lucius seems to have no intentions of listening to humans. Tilith's words are also cause for concern...

name: Unsolvable Riddle
desc: If Lucius is defeated, only Tilith will be able to control the gate. You must think of a countermeasure to deal with the sealed calamities within.

name: Unreachable Solution
desc: You were victorious against all Four Fallen Gods. However, now you fully understand that Lucius's power surpasses that of any previously defeated god.

name: Unspoken Things
desc: Gods and humans seem to be looking at things quite differently. However, if they mean to destroy humanity, you've no choice but to stop them.

name: Unknown Wisdom
desc: Lucius doesn't speak much. Did he fool everyone? Or did humans selfishly come up with their own expectations of him?

name: The Path to Freedom
desc: You wonder if Karl and the others are unharmed. They must have crossed many a powerful enemy on the way here. Quickly, you must reach Lucius!

name: Void of Ignorance
desc: Grand Gaia's Crater... Is this the place where countless calamities lie sealed within? No, now is not the time for distractions.

name: Facing the Sealed God
desc: Tilith has led you all the way here. That was Lucius's will. However, now you must fight with your own will in mind!

name: Squirming Beings
desc: You have reached the depths of this territory sealed by the gods. Within it lies the results of an experiment that offends their divinity...

name: Blooming New Land
desc: The land of the sealed demons, Ishgria. Many different creatures from those in Elgaia can be found here.

name: Dragons & People
desc: A large and strangely designed stone structure stands before you. Obviously from a different culture, it draws both curiosity and fear.

name: A Different Region
desc: In the center of the ruins is a large circular plaza. Though the buildings are abandoned now, this seems to have been a prestigious place.

name: Dangerous Resources
desc: You still feel no presence of menacing demons around you. It was wrong to think that they would be running rampant here, but don't get careless.

name: Large Mallet Snake
desc: From the top of the ruins you see a fantastic view of the land. However, when you remember you have to travel it on foot, your motivation fades.

name: Light's Winged Blade
desc: You've felt no demonic presences until now. It looks like finding the demons in charge of this land will prove harder than you initially thought.

name: Demon Invasion
desc: A demon appears before you and suddenly attacks. There is no escape. Especially now that you'll serve as a sacrifice for the goddess!

name: Fire God's Roar
desc: You never thought that the demon who controls this land would show itself so quickly. Keep your eyes peeled for traps ahead.

name: Infinite Heat
desc: Bridges have been built over the hot vapors that rise from below. One wrong step, and it's all over. You will need a lot of courage to pass through.

name: Hot Current's Blade
desc: Thanks to the rising hot vapors your throat has dried up, and your head feels like it's boiling. Even Paris can't hide the fact that she's struggling.

name: Shining Wings of Fire
desc: You can finally see the exit, but an incredibly hot wind blows from its direction. Apparently its heat source differs from that of the lava below.

name: Opposite of Beauty
desc: You come across some beautiful ponds and cascades which resemble sets of stairs. According to Paris, this water is like acid. Don't go for a dip.

name: Frozen Flower's Dew
desc: This place full of so much dangerous acid makes you wonder if a lot of Ishgria's terrain is similar to this one. It's a bit disconcerting.

name: Crashing Waves
desc: To your surprise you find creatures resembling fish and small shrimp swimming in the acid. This place is definitely different from Elgaia.

name: Vast Region
desc: When you feel something strange on your shoe, you look down to find it has begun to disintegrate. You should watch your step here.

name: Wasted Sea Rocks
desc: You have finally reached the end of the cascades to find yourself in a dark valley of sorts. However, you must defeat a strong enemy to move forward.

name: At Mushroom Forest
desc: You step foot into the thick forest in the valley. However, what surrounds you are giant mushrooms, not trees. You feel like a sort of dwarf...

name: Mushroom Bed
desc: The light cannot reach the depths of this dark forest. Instead, you let yourself be guided through these soft lands by luminous mushrooms.

name: Nature's Roots
desc: You run into something hard while walking. Surprisingly it seems to be the root of a great tree, but you don't remember seeing any trees around...

name: Night of Spore Rain
desc: The aroma of many types of mushrooms mixes in the air. So do their spores. You hope these spores aren't bad for your body, but Paris knows better.

name: Breaker of Silence
desc: It is so quiet that you think you can hear the sound of the spores floating around you. Suddenly though, a ferocious roar breaks the silence.

name: Forbidden Wisdom
desc: Your eyes had just gotten used to the darkness, when a flash of lightning blinds you. The view you see before you includes giant floating crystals.

name: Beacon of Treason
desc: An ominous red light emanates from the chained giant crystals that float midair. To think that you have to walk through such a place...

name: Signs of Collapse
desc: Storms of lightning rage above you, hitting the crystals from time to time. The electricity helps carve stairs and roads on the crystals' surface.

name: Thunder's Direct Hit
desc: You find many rooms within the crystal structures. Do demons live here? Humans wouldn't be able to survive in such a place...

name: Thunder Rock Garden
desc: You managed to make it through this strange place and resurface to land. However, an opponent seems to be preparing to fight you.

name: Overwhelming Light
desc: Lots of preparations are probably being made back home in Elgaia. If possible you want to rescue Tilith before war breaks out, but...

name: Guardian of Splendor
desc: You fight your enemies while a pillar shaped light gleams before you. How does this structure work? A terrible demonic aura surrounds this place.

name: Filled with Light
desc: As you contemplate the Light Tower you begin to wonder about the demon civilization. Do they all have different roles to play as humans do?

name: In Pursuit of Light
desc: A demon named Shusui is said to rule these lands. Is it due to his orders that other demons refuse to show themselves?

name: Noble Light
desc: You're making your way down the tower and will be outside soon. However, the enemies seem to be getting stronger now. Proceed with caution.

name: Hymn of Respite
desc: After exiting the Light Tower, you come across some sparkling trees. Unlike the mushroom forest, these look like real trees, only made of stone.

name: Forest of Shells
desc: Though you've encountered various creatures in the previous terrains, this one is awfully quiet. Is as if all life here has died out.

name: Empty Heart
desc: A building in ruins sleeps within the forest. Completely broken down and in shambles, it resembles the bones of a dead gigantic creature.

name: Blood's Shine
desc: If you look closely, you can see signs of ancient battles having taken place here. You start to wonder what the exiled disciples' battles were like.

name: Secret in the Dark
desc: From an opening in the trees you can see an enormous building in the distance. Is this the Soaring Tree Tower Shusui spoke of? You're almost there.

name: Elementary Steps
desc: The gigantic tower might as well be a skyscraper piercing the sea of clouds. Could its candle-like branches be the stronghold of a demon?

name: Matchless Pair
desc: As thunder rumbles behind you, you enter the mysterious tower. Before you stands a tough enemy whose plans remain unclear. No choice but to continue.

name: Power Barrier
desc: Every enemy awaiting you only seems to get stronger by the minute. You're only halfway through the tower, so there's no time to rest yet.

name: Obstructing Wall
desc: No matter how you think of it, what Shusui says makes little sense. Why is he testing you? You can't read the demon's mind at all.

name: Death God's Purgatory
desc: You can feel a great power ahead, but it doesn't belong to a demon. Could it be Shusui's last trial? Better prepare yourself before proceeding.

name: Tested Power
desc: An entirely different enemy than any of the ones the fallen heroes before you ever faced is expecting you at the top of the tower. Shusui awaits.

name: Awaiting War God
desc: Shusui suddenly shows himself before you once again. Why is he after you now? Does it have to do with something from this land?

name: Lava Rock Furnace
desc: The burning light of the lava inside the caverns tans your skin. The overwhelming black and red colors blind your vision. Don't let your guard down.

name: Rakshasa & Disaster
desc: If you don't watch your step, you may end up stepping in the hot lava. Sticking your foot in there does not look like a good idea.

name: Smoke of Treason
desc: You get an uneasy, yet familiar feeling, and remember the fear of facing a disciple. There's no doubt that a strong enemy awaits ahead.

name: Light Beyond Truth
desc: You follow a hot trail. The ground, walls, and even the ceiling is scorching hot. Your feet feel like they're burning through the soles of your shoes.

name: Burning Claws & Tusks
desc: A ferocious roar echoes through the cavern. At the same time, you feel a cool breeze waft in. It looks like the exit is near.

name: Sea of Steel
desc: The goddess Mora suddenly appears before you. When she mentions she once served Lord Lucius, you can't help but to remember Tilith.

name: The Queen & Ice Tower
desc: You've seen many a spectacular scenery in Ishgria, so now that you're at the Wetlands, you can truly appreciate their bizarre beauty.

name: Tyrannical Foam
desc: You feel anxious knowing a presence near you holds terrible power. The humidity of the wetlands clings to your skin, making you really uncomfortable.

name: Blue Sea Splash
desc: Mora guides you through the Wetlands. Since it's Seria and Lugina, you know they are safe, but you can't help to worry a little.

name: Swirling Scales
desc: There's a faint aroma of sea breeze in the moist air. This change can only mean that the end of the Wetlands is near.

name: Dangerous Imps
desc: The power of a person similar to Karl has been awakened? What could it mean? You hope Karl is safe as you wonder what this is all about.

name: Tempered Demon Rocks
desc: Paris warns that the thick and overgrown plants here are different from the ones in Grand Gaia. Some of them may be poisonous, so be careful.

name: Flower of Starvation
desc: Another bad feeling. That's the third time since you arrived to Lem. Without a doubt, an enemy with great power approaches. Brace yourself.

name: Rebelling Soldier
desc: Pushing your way through an animal trail, you reach a small thicket. Hearing a rustle coming from the bushes, you ready yourself. It was an animal.

name: Forest Bud
desc: The giant trees have cleared out. Now you can probably make it out of the forest quicker. The possibilities of encountering enemies are high though.

name: Roaring Thunder Lands
desc: Paris can't seem to hide her fascination for the ancient dragon. However, you should hurry forward if you want to make sure everyone's okay.

name: Angel of the Heavens
desc: Your body goes slightly numb after approaching an electrified crystal. Best be careful of your surroundings and keep some distance from the crystals.

name: Crushing Flash
desc: You feel something ominous. A frightfully strong enemy is bound to show itself at any minute, but there seems to be no way to escape.

name: Sparkling Lightning
desc: You climb over the great ancient dragon's claws. You don't want to fight an opponent this gigantic, but you may have to in the future...

name: Past Giant Bones
desc: The small electrified crystals have gotten much bigger, and the dragon's bones are almost invisible now. The Ruins can't be far from here.

name: Magic Square of Light
desc: You're surprised by Paris's course of action. You had vaguely noticed a change, but now it's clear that this Paris is more free spirited than before.

name: Weapons & Radiance
desc: You head towards the Ruins in search of Seria and Lugina. Now that Paris is not around, walking behind the silent Mora doesn't feel right.

name: Star of Ruin
desc: A bad feeling overcomes you. A sharp, blood thirsty will made of pure evil draws near. There's nowhere to run, so prepare a good counterattack.

name: Will of Justice
desc: Just how far did Paris go? You can't pick up any presences around you, but whatever you encounter will not be weak. It would be good to regroup.

name: Sparkling Rainbow Sky
desc: Things are happening so suddenly, there is no time to react. What could Mora be thinking? There's no time to ponder about that either.

name: Escaping the Enemy
desc: After being apart for such a long time, you reunite with Seria and Lugina. Now you must begin all preparations necessary to face Mora once again.

name: Demon People
desc: The black rocks and red lava remind you of the first caverns you passed through. It's not that hot here, but you're thrown off by the ominous miasma.

name: Crafty Shadow
desc: A bad feeling once again. You've felt this countless times by now, this evil intent to kill. And combined with the miasma, chills run down your spine.

name: Dark Echoing Song
desc: When you look behind you, it seems as if all the land were illuminated by lightning. Perhaps it's the dragon's suffering. A long bridge stands ahead.

name: Fear Filled Darkness
desc: After climbing down a steep hill, you grow closer to the great bridge. The miasma around you makes everything creepier as it points towards the enemy.

name: Past the Bridge
desc: The demon Mora finally reveals her true identity. She says that if you wish to know Karl's whereabouts, you must defeat her first. Can you trust her?

name: Dark God's Trap
desc: Crossing the great bridge with Lugina reminds you of your time in Lizeria. With that in mind you wonder how your relationship has made it this far.

name: Guide to Calamity
desc: Thanks to Paris and Lugina's help, you won't face many traps along the way. But the demons Mora has sent come at you one after another.

name: Messenger of Despair
desc: You may have beaten a disciple, but its presence is not completely gone. Countless disciple-like demons come after you, but you're only halfway there.

name: War Ravages Anew
desc: It's battle after battle, but while caught up in them you feel a new, yet strange power approaching. It feels familiar somehow though...

name: Truth and Falsehood
desc: After defeating Shusui anew, you head towards the end of the bridge. However, you feel that demonic presence again. You know which demon awaits now.

name: Smiling Trickster
desc: The demon Mora suddenly appears before you again. What is a demon's shadow? And just what could be going on in Ishgria?

name: Blistering March
desc: The lava before you makes you falter a little. No matter how many trying places you've visited, you'll need resolve to get out of this one.

name: Fire Dragon's Nest
desc: The air carries the fiery breath of a dragon. There's no doubt that a group of them is nearby. Best move quietly to avoid any confrontations.

name: Color of Fire
desc: It's so hot you want to resort to Lugina's rude vocabulary to describe the temperature. Your skin stings too, perhaps because you're a bit burnt?

name: Roaring Pyre
desc: The sound of the lava flow is unexpectedly pleasant, until you suddenly hear a deafening roar. It might be smart to prepare for battle.

name: Lava Pool
desc: This hell-like lava path seems to be almost over. However, menacing presences still lurk about. Could this be the demon's assassins?

name: Scarlet Seashore
desc: Very impactful scenery suddenly comes into view. A deep red sea spreads before your eyes. Its hue makes you realize anew you're in another world.

name: Red Tide
desc: Though the sea has a red tint to it, its smell is not strange at all. This disparity makes you uncomfortable and highly confuses you.

name: Rouge Sea
desc: You've seen the sea dyed by the colors of the sunset before, but you're sure this water's hue is something entirely different. You start feeling sick.

name: Struggle to the Death
desc: The "Six Armors" that Mora mentioned, which rival demonic powers, start to bug you. You may have to fight them in the future.

name: Waves of Blood
desc: Are all of Ishgria's oceans red? While thinking that to yourself, a horde of enemies shows up. This is no time to take it easy.

name: Leftover Mark
desc: Seria was right. This place really doesn't resemble a laboratory. However, if you look closely you'll see a lot of strange equipment.

name: Eroded by the Forest
desc: The ruins turned laboratory are being swallowed by the forest. You can feel great vitality coming from the plants growing along the walls.

name: Foliage Valley
desc: Even though the facility has been eroded by the forest, a part of it still seems to be alive. The science behind it was indeed efficient.

name: Dangerous Scent
desc: A very misplaced and dense floral aroma drifts in the air. You still don't know much about Ishgria's nature, so you would do well to be cautious.

name: Shield & Lance
desc: You're almost out of the laboratory, but Lugina and Paris are still nowhere to be seen. Seria's also taken her own path, so just keep moving forward.

name: Dangerous Wind
desc: As something fearsome drops from the heavens and comes after you, you realize there is no room to talk. The battle has already started.

name: Heavenly Wind
desc: The strong wind doesn't cease blowing. The wood of the gigantic and heavy windmill towering over you makes a loud creaking noise as it turns.

name: Gale Path
desc: The strong wind may be somewhat depressing, but at least it's neither too hot nor too cold. There's no apparent danger in sight either.

name: Alarming Squall
desc: A violent squall almost sent you flying. Looks like this is yet another place where you can't let your guard down. Be careful.

name: Strong Wind Dynamics
desc: Though the windmill seems pretty old, it is still in very good condition, and even mobile. Could this have been the energy source for the lab?

name: Beiorg Strikes Again
desc: Beiorg shows himself before you again. Would it be wise to fight this enemy with a function that makes him stronger after every defeat?

name: Temple Ruins
desc: While looking at the landscape you realize that both demons and humans must have lived here long ago. Could humans really have inhabited Ishgria?

name: Aurora Boulevard
desc: After passing numerous alleys on a hill, you finally find the main road. However, where could the inhabitants of such a great city have gone?

name: Star Lane
desc: When you turn on a corner of the main road, you see that a group of enemies has been waiting for you. Could these be the protectors of this old city?

name: Ivory Castle
desc: You have reached the outer wall of the old city. It may be due to the materials it's made of, but it's still somehow untarnished and pearly white.

name: Persistent Attacks
desc: If you climb this set of strange-looking stairs, you will reach the old castle. However, climbing all these stairs is slightly depressing.

name: Curtain of Night
desc: The stairs keep going up, and up. You start to worry about Owen, but according to what Seria and Lugina said, you just have to trust he's fine.

name: Decaying Corpses
desc: Even though there seems to be no end to this staircase, the enemies don't find it a problem to attack you. Be careful not to miss your step and fall.

name: Shadow of Coercion
desc: Due to the nature of this place, you can't avoid any fights. On top of that, enemies keep attacking you from high places, so you're in a tough spot.

name: Awaiting the End
desc: You can see the entrance to the castle. Once you clear the next wave of enemies, you should be able to go inside. That's where the real battle awaits.

name: Mechanized Fortress
desc: You destroy all the mechanisms you see before you as you move forth. It's possible that Karl is here, but what would he be doing in this place?

name: Circuit Courtyard
desc: As you look at the lights that flash on the floors and walls, you feel as if you had been swallowed by a giant machine. Perhaps that's what happened?

name: Wired Hall
desc: You keep destroying all the equipment you lay your eyes upon, but nothing seems to happen. What is the purpose of all these gadgets anyway?

name: Throne of Gears
desc: Beiorg seems to be able to alter his stature and size, but there's no way he'd make the castle a part of his body...is there?

name: Gate of Driving Force
desc: By the way, where did Beiorg run off to? If this place is as important as Mora claims, then he should be here to protect it, and yet...

name: Indestructible Arms
desc: As you wander around the silent castle, you hear a strange sound echo through its halls. It seems like Beiorg is on his way to you after all!

name: Destroyed God
desc: Behind the castle and down the cliff lies a forest of dry trees. Will another demonic shadow show itself here? No more demons should be around, but...

name: The First Summoner
desc: Owen says one shouldn't have overly positive expectations. Let your guard down for a second, and you will be defeated. Better prepare yourself well.

name: A City Ablaze
desc: The city is burning. What could be the fuel of these flames, and when will they stop burning? Ishgria is truly a strange place.

name: Rain of Fire
desc: Speckles of fire keep falling like rain. What could have happened to this place that is now burning? The mystery only deepens.

name: Overwhelming Fire
desc: The inside of the structure is as hot as a furnace. A minute longer inside, and you'll be cooked alive. Hurry towards the giant flowers.

name: Within the Smoke
desc: As you pass the city, the fire is not as intense, but the amount of smoke is overwhelming. Breathing it in could be dangerous, so hurry along.

name: Stagnant Water
desc: You reach a lifeless lake housing water that is clearly not meant for drinking. The miasma that has settled in the place makes your stay unbearable.

name: Poison-Filled Lake
desc: The stench makes you frown as you stumble about. If you spend too long here, your insides may just get poisoned.

name: Rising Miasma
desc: The atmosphere is terrible. It must be hard for the demons to live here, but impossible for humans to do the same. It weakens the spirit.

name: Polluted Water
desc: A section of the lake seems to be boiling. However, it's not water springing forth, nor is the water really boiling. It's the effect of pollution.

name: Within the Mud
desc: Could this lake and the burning city have been in their current state since the beginning? Or is there a reason behind their extreme conditions?

name: Giant Miasma Flowers
desc: The giant flowers which gave this region its name finally come into sight. The miasma they release is so strong, it can be seen with the naked eye...

name: Sprinkling Miasma
desc: Could the flowers' miasma be pollen? The miasma that fills the air is even more hazardous to one's health than the lake's pollution.

name: Scattered Pollen
desc: You begin to feel dizzy. The miasma is starting to take its toll. Cover your mouth with some cloth, and try not to breathe it all in.

name: Within the Stench
desc: Why would these dangerous plants settle in the city ruins? Do they not affect the demons as well? That seems improbable somehow...

name: Rotting Body
desc: You encounter a revolting creature. If you don't get out of here now, your body will suffer irreparable damage.

name: Gushing Power
desc: Who could that creepy man have been? He looked human enough, but...does he live in Ishgria? He can't be trusted.

name: Thunder Path
desc: Could crossing this long bridge made entirely of metal be really safe? Lightning won't stop flashing, so you can't seem to calm down...

name: Lightning Run
desc: The bridge is very high up, and falling would send you head-first into the red water below. Your chances of surviving such a fall are slim though...

name: Someone Draws Near
desc: Treading carefully, you cross the bridge with extreme caution. Touching it could lead to an electric shock, so you don't want to fight here, but...

name: Within the Electricity
desc: You had no idea of what to do when Shusui attacked you on such a narrow bridge, but you somehow survived the encounter. Just a little further now.

name: Remaining Light
desc: Karl said he still has his doubts, and those words echo in your head. However, the enemy could care less and attacks you.

name: Luminous Tower
desc: The fluids of demons lie scattered around everywhere, making you feel sick. Mora claimed it was because of the flowers' miasma, but...

name: Overflowing Light
desc: That demon seems to have been Lucius's old disciple, but you've heard nothing of the sort before. Would Ark know about him?

name: Flickering Past
desc: What could have happened to Owen and that man? Owen would never fall for the traps lying around these parts, but...

name: Within the Flashes
desc: As you go deeper within the lair, you feel a cold chill about you. Could there be something at the bottom? You should go take a look.

name: Hole of Darkness
desc: What could have that man meant to say? He said he resents the Summoners of Old...so could he be a Summoner himself?

name: Demon Crystal Cave
desc: Crystals that sparkle amidst the darkness are beautiful. They are lovely to look at, but could they really be as dangerous as that man claims?

name: Falling Shadow
desc: You've heard many legends that tell of beautiful crystals which can grant demonic powers. Could these be the same crystals of lore?

name: Secretive Demon
desc: The enemies here are stronger than those outside. Could it be the work of the crystals? Be careful not to get possessed by them.

name: Within the Darkness
desc: You know you're almost out of the cave when you feel a draft. The old castle where the demon Melord awaits shouldn't be too far now.

name: Arrogance
desc: You don't mind being entrusted with Karl, but you want to discuss what's going on with him. Look for Karl as soon as you finish that demon.

name: Beacon of Opposition
desc: The castle is in shambles. The passage of time, the influence of that rotting demon, and Owen's rage must have destroyed it. Time to find that demon.

name: Submissive Power
desc: Grahdens mentioned that someone in Ishgria resents the Summoners of Old. However, the existence of such a creature is surprising in itself.

name: Scorn & Envy
desc: As you go deeper into the castle, a familiar stench hits your nostrils. Melord seems to be near, so hurry towards him.

name: Shining Lamp
desc: The slime on the walls is still fresh. You hear something that sounds like Owen on a rampage. You have to keep moving forward.

name: Losing Oneself
desc: Melord, Lucius's former disciple, now lives as a demon corrupted by the miasma and demon crystals. Make sure you're in top shape for this fight.

name: Sealed God's Disciple
desc: You find Melord in a graveyard of rotting ships. Now the disciple of the Sealed God comes after you to do the bidding of his master!

name: Flowing Heat
desc: Lava flows systematically around this place, creating black smoke. According to Mora, this place is based on a factory from another world.

name: Sickening Heat
desc: Owen advances even farther. The cowardly enemies that have avoided his path now come after you in return.

name: Burning Splash
desc: The heat of the lava intensifies the atmosphere around you. Fighting under these conditions makes it hard to breathe. Careful not to break something.

name: Within the Melting Point
desc: Apparently, what's flowing around is not lava, but molten metal. Is someone trying to build something with all this material?

name: Endless Fire
desc: A wind that could burn your skin comes blasting in. This doesn't seem to be a part of the factory, but of a strong enemy waiting ahead.

name: Within the Light
desc: Paris was concerned about the large number of liquid-type monsters, but it seems those creatures can adapt to the habitat of any world.

name: Outrageous Torrent
desc: Luminous water flows freely around you. Could the speckles of light in it be bugs? Even the flowers growing around the basin seem to glow.

name: Shining Ripples
desc: Is this glowing water safe to drink? You spot a Squirty playing in it and can't help but wonder if this is the source of its larger evolutions.

name: Dancing Lights
desc: Though this shiny water is strange, it is beautiful in its own way. If there were no danger lurking about, it would be the perfect place for a stroll.

name: Solemn River of Light
desc: The smell of the coast wafts in, though there is no ocean in sight. It's safer to assume that a powerful enemy is behind it instead.

name: Growing Power
desc: Karl's secrecy has you very upset. But it doesn't seem like he has changed at the core, so that relieves you somewhat.

name: Circle of Life
desc: Seemingly a clump of plants from afar, from up close one can see that a lot of care was put into planting these trees. This garden was man-made.

name: Jumping Plants
desc: The glass ceiling lets a strange light shine in. This light and the temperature are both regulated, making the perfect environment for these plants.

name: Fragrance of Nature
desc: Taking a closer look, you notice there are also plants from Elgaia in this garden. Scientists could potentially make great discoveries in this place.

name: Artificial Nature
desc: You're taken aback by the great tree in the middle of the garden. Could it be the great and otherworldly Alpha Tree?

name: Accumulating Wreckage
desc: Mirfah challenges you to a duel to learn your true intentions. You cannot just ignore him, so prepare yourself and do the best you can.

name: Rumbling Earthquake
desc: Independence from the gods. This is a story you have heard a few times before. However, you must press forward for Tilith's sake.

name: Broken Order
desc: There are pieces of machinery scattered all over the place. They are piled up so high that you fear they make come crashing down.

name: Scattered Past
desc: Could these metal scraps have been part of a failed experiment to revive otherworldly techniques? In that case, this place could be a treasure trove.

name: Ruins Full of Power
desc: A thunderous roar makes the metal scraps come crashing down. This beast's underground cry resonates in the air. A powerful enemy must await ahead.

name: Brilliant Megalopolis
desc: A bright light shines over the great metropolis. Its size and structure rival those of Randall. However, oddly enough, no one seems to live here.

name: Ten Thousand Lights
desc: Could developed metropolises such as this one exist in other worlds? Perhaps Randall will come to resemble it someday .

name: Nightless Castle
desc: Could the demon ruling this land be an entirely different being? So far it doesn't seem interested in a fight.

name: Dashing Ray of Light
desc: Though you're wondering why the demon of this land has not sought you out, don't forget that a certain persistent demon may come seeking a fight.

name: Towards the Light
desc: There is a great disc shining from above. It looks like it's at the top of a tower. However, there's something odd about it...

name: The World Below
desc: You descend into a gloomy underground road completely different from the world above. The walls and floor are dirty, and even the air feels polluted.

name: Suppressive Corruption
desc: The world above was magnificent, but the world below leaves much to be desired. Why would demons come all the way down here looking for shelter?

name: Secret in the Dark
desc: You can't help but wonder how people would be able to live underground in this place if it were truly a possibility.

name: Treacherous Heart
desc: Underneath the city of light there is a place the light cannot touch. Even if technology fixed this in the future, society wouldn't probably allow it.

name: City of Shadows
desc: There seems to be an even deeper darkness lurking ahead. Walking this underground city makes you feel like you've fallen into the underworld.

name: Clear Skies
desc: It turns out Mordlim was just like the demons before it--an enemy of humanity. What Mora said still has you worried, but you must defeat this demon.

name: Pouring Rain
desc: Not only can this device control the weather, but it can also cause disasters automatically. Such dangerous technology must be used with caution.

name: Enshrouding Clouds
desc: Perhaps if Elgaia had the power this tower possesses, there wouldn't be a need for humanity to fight the demons.

name: Blowing Wind
desc: The more you think about it, the more Mordlim's plans sound terrifying. How would've things played out if you hadn't done anything about it?

name: Freedom
desc: You can feel that the demon has a powerful foes awaiting you. A great foe climbs its way to the top, while another descends from above. This is it.

name: Master of Creation
desc: Unbeknownst to anyone, Mordlim had continued with her sinister plans. If you don't stop her now, the future of humankind could be lost forever!

name: Curious Lesser Gods
desc: There is a secret sky garden behind the botanical garden. You're pretty sure you will encounter the demon Mordlim there, though she's been defeated.

name: Defiant Flames
desc: Having passed through lava belts all across the land, you should be used to places like this. Avoid taking risks, and watch your step.

name: Commander of Flames
desc: It seems the demon that rules this land has hair a color unlike any you have seen thus far. You could say it's very demonic, or not demonic at all.

name: Magician's Blaze
desc: The air here pulses with the heat. It is so intense that your sweat evaporates in an instant. Stay hydrated, and always be prepared for combat.

name: Chaotic Fires
desc: The enemies you face at every turn here are quite strong. However, you have built up ample power to defeat them. Move ahead boldly!

name: Breaching Black Fires
desc: An incandescent wind blows by. The lava road seems to have an exit ahead, where the heat is most intense. A formidable foe most likely awaits you.

name: An Icy Gaze
desc: Mora continues to use you. It might be time to start thinking about what she aims to achieve with all her plotting.

name: Trio of Brilliant Ice
desc: A metallic scent unlike the rusted iron smell of the red sea tickles your nose. It seems that Elgaian common sense doesn't apply to Ishgria.

name: Blue Tower of Ice
desc: Mora said that it was impossible to comprehend Amu Yunos's thinking, but you have a feeling that the same is true of her and Shusui.

name: Howl of the Icy Sea
desc: Suddenly, you can smell the salty breeze from a familiar sea. You should assume that this kind of change indicates a strong enemy is on its way.

name: Ice Battle Dance
desc: You can see a dense forest ahead of you. It seems you will need to pass through it to reach the tower. Proceed down this beach just a little further.

name: Insatiable Forest
desc: It's good you were able to ask Karl's opinion. Even if your objectives are different, Karl wants to help Tilith just as much as you do.

name: Dancing Greenery
desc: As you head to the ruins that the forest has enveloped, you catch unsettling glimpses of what seems to be a giant through the trees.

name: Trembling Forest
desc: The ancient cobblestones are so overgrown with moss that they are hardly recognizable. This seems like a nice place for a walk, a rarity in Ishgria.

name: Forest Boundaries
desc: The trees around you began to rustle. A wind is blowing past, deeper into the forest. It seems someone is inviting you in. Be prepared for battle.

name: Forested Battle Lines
desc: When you think about it, you haven't seen Shusui for a while. Could he have given up? If so, you shouldn't need to worry about him, but...

name: Guiding Thunder
desc: The sky is filled with black clouds that flash with never-ending lightning. All there is to see around you is an expanse of barren earth.

name: Thunderous Sky
desc: Since you have a good view and allies with you, you can focus on enemies approaching from ahead. But watch your back just in case.

name: Defiant Thunder
desc: Lightning flashes, illuminating the sky. You hear an earsplitting roar and a suspicious shadow passes high above. It seems you have airborne enemies.

name: Wild Thunder Valley
desc: You heard a cliff collapsing over the thunder. Something large is approaching, shaking the earth as it does. You won't get away without fighting.

name: Splendid Thunderclaps
desc: You made your way close to the castle. Now you need to climb a trail up the cliffs, but you'll have to fight difficult foes here as well.

name: Light of Annihilation
desc: You have learned what the Akras Summoners' Hall was truly after. And you think it might tie into saving Tilith. There's no room for hesitation now.

name: Judgment of the Light
desc: This castle seems to be quite old, but it doesn't look weathered at all. Actually, it seems in excellent condition. Is someone maintaining it?

name: Shining White Light
desc: Despite its formidable exterior, inside the castle is refined and sophisticated. It's said that Amu Yunos has always ruled this land, but...

name: Praying to the Light
desc: From this high up in the castle, you are able to see the giant's face directly. Once again, you are amazed at its unimaginable size.

name: Advent of Holy Light
desc: It seems there's a passage that extends from the castle to the neighboring mountains, offering an exit. But it also appears to lead toward the giant.

name: Evil in the Darkness
desc: You sensed something from Mora that wasn't there before; something like confusion. You feel like you understand Seria's concern a little better.

name: Dark Necromancy
desc: You sense an almost-familiar presence. It could be that Shusui has caught up with you. Time to hurry.

name: Through the Darkness
desc: The great giant's remains seem to be holding their form without decaying or breaking down. Is this the power of Amu Yunos at work?

name: Realm of Darkness
desc: Even while untouched by decay, the giant's corpse somehow makes you starkly aware of death. Are you over-thinking things?

name: Dark Phantom Aura
desc: You have reached the giant's feet. You should be able to walk to Amu Yunos's tower from here. You must be prepared for anything.

name: Quiet Skies
desc: You never dreamed that a demon would call you chaotic. Maybe you should be more aware of the things you've done so far.

name: Uncertain Moon
desc: You defeated the Four Fallen Gods and Lucius, and now demons fall before you wherever you go. Will you also take out Karna Masta in the future?

name: Viewing the Galaxy
desc: Mora said that eight of them sealed Karna Masta, which means there are two other demons besides Amu Yunos.

name: Intoxicating Stars
desc: You need to defeat the demons to save Tilith. But if you do that, the seal on Karna Masta will break...

name: Ends Yet Unseen
desc: Before you knew it, the top floor was but a few steps away. It's dangerous to fight while distracted. Make sure to keep yourself together.

name: Hour of Disaster
desc: Amu Yunos is a demon you must face to save Tilith. That's all the reason you need to fight. Prepare for battle.

name: Time to Move
desc: For some reason, you have to face Owen now. If you refuse, Owen will probably flatten you anyway. So your only choice is to take him head on!

name: Hour of Agreement
desc: When you step into the glistening crystal cave, it seems there is a demon deep within. Amu Yunos's Shadow likely awaits you.

name: Retribution Demon
desc: You sense serenity in Mirfah's expression, unlike before. Sometimes, fighting just to see who's strongest feels good.

name: Dragon Disciple Raid
desc: An individual with the head of a dragon suddenly attacks. He identifies himself as a follower of the land's demon ruler, and you must fight back.

name: Calamity's Howling
desc: Disciple Liomerg addressed Karl respectfully. It seems that the demon in Karl's bloodline is the ruler of this land.

name: Uphill Invasion
desc: The flames form first a firestorm, then spin into towering fire whirls. Who knows what happens if you get close to them. Be careful as you advance!

name: Defense and Counters
desc: It might be your imagination, but it seems like the enemies here are much more self-aware than any before, and that their attacks are more strategic.

name: Battle Tendency
desc: You're almost clear of the land of burning winds. Your clothes smell a bit charred. You've got to hurry ahead before they catch fire.

name: Sunken City
desc: Karl seems dead set on fighting no matter what. You're not done trying to talk him down yet, but you may need to face him in combat.

name: Towering Shadows
desc: You feel you need to defeat Karna Masta. If you don't, humanity will forever live in fear of the god's resurrection.

name: Tragic Destiny
desc: You really want to believe in Karl. Despite this, you don't think the demon menace will go away even if Ishgria is unified.

name: Origin of Resistance
desc: Even if Karna Masta weren't a threat, you would need to eliminate the demon threat in order to free Tilith.

name: The Guide of Eras
desc: Regardless of whatever the demon Barion thought, you can't be sure without actually meeting it. Time to get moving.

name: Clash of Powers
desc: A beautiful view of the continent extends before you. Compared to some other places, it's actually quite scenic.

name: Dividing Walls
desc: Circle around a cliff, climb a slope, look for a path, and climb back down, again and again. But you caught sight of something like a waterfall ahead.

name: Insurmountable Rise
desc: On cresting a particularly high hill, you realized that the waterfall was actually a structure damming the river. You will need to get through it.

name: Sheltered Crossroads
desc: Suddenly, you remember Mora's words. You can't imagine her becoming an ally, but if possible, you'd rather not have her as an enemy.

name: Do-or-Die Resolve
desc: You can faintly hear what seems to be rushing water. That dam-like structure must be close. The enemies are fighting harder, as well.

name: Deadly Gatekeeper
desc: There's nothing you can say to Paris in her distress. You just have to believe she'll find an answer for herself.

name: Open Road Ahead
desc: Apparently, this massive dam also functions as a fortress. The interior is maze-like, and it won't be easy to get through.

name: Obstructing the Path
desc: Formidable foes lie in wait at key points. As you fight an unpleasant thought crosses your mind, and you wonder if Karl sent them there.

name: A Tricky Bottleneck
desc: You have gotten lost in the fortress. You need to focus on moving ahead after all, without getting distracted by pointless questions.

name: Heart of The Citadel
desc: You arrived at the fortress's dam control room. According to the map found in the room, you should be able to get out from here.

name: Welcoming Gate
desc: It seems that Karl wasn't able to fully awaken the demonic power within himself. Perhaps he still has some doubts...

name: Plaza of Worship
desc: If Karl is still uncertain, you know what you need to do. Eliminate the threats of the demons and Karna Masta, and save Tilith.

name: Noble City
desc: You leave the plaza and find yourself on the main street. Across the bridge ahead is the gate to the outskirts of town. Liomerg is probably there.

name: Bridge of Purity
desc: Apparently, formidable foes await you on the bridge. You want to conserve your strength before fighting Liomerg, but that may be impossible.

name: Past Death's Door
desc: Liomerg stands before the gate. You don't see Karl, but he's probably watching. You can't embarrass yourself now.

name: Spider's Web
desc: This isn't your first fight with Lugina. But he says he'll show you a new power he had kept hidden, so this won't go like the last time.

name: Frayed Threads
desc: You're advancing across a gigantic spider's web. The thick threads are stable, but watch your step. Especially since you're up against Lugina.

name: Between the Threads
desc: Lose your footing and you'll fall into the depths. It seems like there's water down there, but this is Ishgria. You won't come out unscathed.

name: Woven Power
desc: Lugina's fighting spirit... That feeling you get when you face a formidable foe... You need to get serious, before Lugina summons his true strength.

name: Knife-Edged Battle
desc: You see Lugina laughing as though he's invincible. He has the advantage no matter where you approach from. Be careful, and give it your all!

name: Dragon Talon Breaker
desc: As expected, it's difficult to talk with demons. But they might be more cooperative if you demonstrate your power?

name: Piercing Dragon Horn
desc: You head for the summit, defeating one enemy after another. You start to wonder if demons are only capable of understanding others through combat.

name: Dragon Scale Defense
desc: You approach the midpoint of the mountain trail. Ahead, at the peak, you can sense a presence so powerful it stifles your spirit. Is it a dragon?

name: Flying Dragon Dance
desc: A gate capable of moving Karna Masta, seal and all... But you're worried that a power on that level just might break the seal.

name: Blinding Dragon Speed
desc: You see Liomerg on the final incline before the peak. This is probably the end of the line. Get ready for a decisive battle!

name: Ascended Dragon's Eye
desc: Only the demon Barion remains. If you can't win here, it would be foolish to face Karna Masta. It's time to show your power!

name: Watchful Guide
desc: You have to face the demon Kalon's Shadow alongside Lugina. The true seal on Karna Masta should break soon as well. The time to fight draws near.

name: Thunderbird Awakens
desc: It's been a long time since you fought with Paris. She wants to fight to overcome her doubts. With that in mind, you want to give your all.

name: Persistent Flame
desc: Mora states her goal is to unify the world and end all conflict. But she is a demon, too. For that reason alone she won't avoid friction.

name: Yesterday's Glory
desc: Mora didn't come out and say it, but she wants help. Even so, everyone is resolved. They can't accede to her ambitions.

name: Unfailing Light
desc: It seems this facility pumps up oil from beneath the sea floor. A lot of devices made with otherworldly technologies use this oil.

name: Surging Vigor
desc: Some of the oil that is pumped up is burned to remove impurities. That is why this facility belches forth flames endlessly.

name: Smokey Battle
desc: Clouds of black, poisonous smoke stand in your way. You want to hurry ahead to the snowy plains after Mora, but the enemies in your way come first.

name: Ice Fissures
desc: Your allies seem alright. Rescue can wait; focus on fighting Mora. Your fate was to face her. Hopefully this will be the last time for it, though.

name: Endless White
desc: You must assemble demonic powers to face Karna Masta. That means that if Mora wasn't lying, you'll need her help.

name: Freezing Wrath
desc: A raging wind chills you to the bone, and drowns out the sound of your footsteps. All you can see is white, and you still have a long way to go.

name: Unwavering
desc: You can barely keep to the path due to the blizzard. But you won't lose sight of your goal. Advance without wavering, so you can rescue Tilith.

name: Snowy Welcome
desc: All you can do is focus on advancing as you push through deep snowdrifts. Suddenly a fierce wind springs up, and the blizzard intensifies.

name: Frozen Pines
desc: You were finally released from the blizzard's abuse thanks to your arrival in the frozen woods. But the cold is unchanged, and your hands are numb.

name: Transparent Heart
desc: It feels as though time itself has frozen in the silence of these woods. You let out a deep sigh, and continue to advance steadily.

name: Grove of Flurries
desc: Snow falls through the gaps between trees. Sometimes, a clump falls from the branches noisily, startling you by sounding like an enemy's approach.

name: Silent White Woods
desc: The white snow and dark trees deceive your eyes. Deep snowdrifts entangle your legs. Protracted fighting here is harder than you imagined.

name: White Continent
desc: The trees have thinned out. You are almost out of the woods, and you miss warmer lands. Hopefully somewhere more sheltered is coming up next.

name: Electrified Gates
desc: There is a gate of appropriate size for the immense valley it blocks off built across the precipice. It seems to be mechanical.

name: Moment of Insight
desc: A single path extends toward the mechanical gate. It seems you will have to fight Shusui here after all. Prepare yourself.

name: Lightning Speed
desc: There's something weird and mechanical on the path. Could it be a device for transferring power generated at the oil well?

name: Crossing Currents
desc: While it's better than the plains or the woods, it's still cold here. It's so cold that you're almost eager to fight with Shusui already.

name: The Name Shusui
desc: Is Shusui covered in wounds from his battle with Owen? Or was it one of Mora's traps? Either way, you can't hold back against him.

name: Scattering Light
desc: You are finally free of the cold. Truthfully, it's cold here too, but still so much warmer than you have been for a while. You feel alive again.

name: Illuminated Path
desc: You're inside a cave, but its walls of transparent ice let the outside light shine in. It reflects off every surface, eliminating all shadows.

name: A Bright Future
desc: Sound reverberates in the cave just as light reflects. Your footsteps echo many times over, and it sounds almost like you're leading a small army.

name: Reflected Light
desc: You emerged into a spacious cavern. The refracted light is concentrated here, and some of the ice is melted. It's also a bit warm, thankfully.

name: Captivating Lands
desc: Your eyes are growing tired, possibly because of the shining cave. They're also dry, and your vision is blurry. Getting attacked now would be risky.

name: Cold, Dark Places
desc: Lugina said Karl's kindness was weakness. So what is strength? In all its grandeur, nature gives no answer.

name: Closed Paths
desc: A vicious, howling wind rolls over the side of the cliffs. Your body is stripped of all the warmth it accumulated within the cave in an instant.

name: Wall of Darkness
desc: You climb the path that juts out from the ice wall. At each crossroads you come across you must choose the safest-looking one from many options.

name: Impartial Clarity
desc: You should arrive at the castle where Mora awaits once you make it up this cliff. Looking up or down is terrifying, but you just have to keep going.

name: Sub-zero Cliffs
desc: You've gotten close to the top. If you lose your footing here you're finished, yet your enemies fight without concern for the location. Be careful.

name: Blockaded Gate
desc: You proceed down the path that Lugina and Seria cleared as they went ahead. But then enemies appeared, as though they were waiting. It's an ambush.

name: Frozen Past
desc: This former stronghold of a demon leader is as elegant and impressive as you would expect. Even long years later, that hasn't changed.

name: Closed Doors
desc: It's said that the demons fell into an era of chaotic war after their leader left. It would appear this castle's purpose was lost afterwards, as well.

name: Bound Memories
desc: The two Summoners of Old are here, as are Bertz and Liomerg. The key will probably be whoever finds Mora first.

name: Forbidden Hopes
desc: Apparently, this castle's original master had un-demonly dreams of eliminating conflict. Mora said she was taking up that quest, but...

name: Gathering Powers
desc: Alongside Seria, you challenge Mora. Having absorbed the other demons, Mora is much stronger than ever before. Don't hold back!

name: Spiritual Heir
desc: Postpone your happiness for reuniting with Tilith and defeat Mora! Now is your chance, while her power is out of control!

name: Desire to be the Best
desc: Face Seria's feelings, and give this battle your all. It will help your friend find her own path.

name: True Dragon's Power
desc: Barion shows his true power and form. Face him alongside Karl, whose demonic powers have awakened! The answer Karl seeks must lie ahead.

name: God Sealing Gate
desc: It seems Kalon knows who lies ahead. But no matter what foe awaits, you must defeat the Holy Emperor with Tilith.

name: The Blazing Gate
desc: The blazing gate opens, scorching the very air. Under cover of billowing smoke, countless enemies have poured forth. Don't let them slow you down.

name: Burning Battlefield
desc: Hellish flames roar all around. You must conserve your strength as you dispatch the approaching foes. The path looks longer than anticipated.

name: Dancing Sparks
desc: As you clear the gate, the heat fades, but the onslaught intensifies. Behind you, enemy reinforcements leap down from above the gate.

name: Hellfire Whirlwind
desc: Enemy resistance has subsided. One last group blocks your way. Dispatch them, and you can finally escape the influence of the Eight Sealed Gods' Gate.

name: Incessant Heat
desc: Boiling water gushes from deep within the earth, and falls on you like scalding rain. But you must focus on the enemies at hand.

name: Before the Storm
desc: As Lugina suggests, the lack of resistance so far is perplexing. You should seize the chance to press forward.

name: Battle at the Geyser
desc: The craggy ground is slick with mud, and dotted with sinkholes connected by fierce streams. This footing is every soldier's worst nightmare.

name: Scalding Spray
desc: Rock crumbles underfoot, unleashing a jet of scalding water and nearly sending you sprawling. The slightest misstep could cost your life.

name: Torrential Floods
desc: The expanse of countless hazardous geysers finally nears its end. An ominous feeling grows, as you realize it won't continue to be this easy...

name: Budding Doubt
desc: The end of summoning arts? With the final battle impending, you have no time to consider the ramifications. But, it remains at the back of your mind.

name: Silent Ruins
desc: All around you lie mercilessly crushed ruins, now covered with young forest. The foreboding silence tempts the mind to wander.

name: Waltz of Impatience
desc: Moment by moment, the final battle draws near. How can you hope to overcome the might of the Holy Emperor, who overshadowed even the Summoners of Old?

name: Into the Deep Green
desc: Amidst the deep green, you exhale deeply. At your side are Tilith and your companions. Lament will only sap your resolve. It's time to move on.

name: The Sea of Trees
desc: Bertz's words seep into your heart like poison. But if you can't shake off something like this, you'll never stand a chance against the Holy Emperor.

name: Guardian of the Seal
desc: The demon Kalon has watched over the seals of many lands. This must be a trial to gauge your worthiness. Show your strength!

name: Atop the Wreckage
desc: Karna Masta defeated even the Summoners of Old, but with the Oracle Maiden's power, you can challenge him. You must hold on to even the faintest hope.

name: The Ravaged Land
desc: This place has been so utterly ravaged that its original purpose is a mystery. Such is the power of the Holy Emperor...

name: Scorched Heart
desc: The broken ground makes for treacherous footing, but just brushing the surroundings with your hand could blast you with electricity. Be cautious.

name: Violet Lightning
desc: Some of the surrounding wreckage is relatively intact. You marvel at the unfamiliar materials and workmanship. Could these be otherworldly relics?

name: Oracle and Prayer
desc: Ark will attack with everything he has. Remain steadfast as you face him, and convince him to aid your cause.

name: Fading Light
desc: You have never seen such a peaceful expression as on Ark's face. You silently gaze upon the gentle, yet sad countenance.

name: Heart of Radiance
desc: You have at last reached the heart of the brilliantly shining structure. This area is also heavily damaged, leaving you to wonder what it once was.

name: Sparkling Castle
desc: This must have once been a very important location. Some massive power lingers here, throwing off dazzling flashes of light.

name: Coming of the Light
desc: As your eyes adjust to the light, you find your way outside the structure. The sudden plunge into blackness leaves you disoriented and vulnerable.

name: Vexing Worldscape
desc: You emerge in a place defying description. It must be the ruins of a city...but nothing makes sense. So this is how this other world looks.

name: Incomprehensible Path
desc: Cutting through a maze of alleys, you find yourself indoors, then underground. You wonder how the inhabitants avoided losing their way.

name: Eerie Shadows
desc: The cities filled with otherworldly technology you have seen before were filled with light, but this place becomes darker with each step.

name: Conquer the Dark
desc: Lights flicker here and there, but only make it more difficult to peer into the shadows. Before your eyes can adjust, you press on ahead.

name: Darkest Night
desc: On the outskirts of town, you feel a familiar air of destitution and desperation. You suppose the bad areas are not much different in any world.

name: Blinding Fog
desc: You have finally reached the place where the Holy Emperor Karna Masta was sealed. Make haste to find Ilia's power for the remaining Summoners of Old.

name: The Domain of Despair
desc: Parting the thick mist, you search for any sign of Ilia. You feel the overpowering aura of a mighty god, but can find no trace of the Oracle Maiden.

name: Unknowable Power
desc: You must buy time while Ark awakens Ilia's power. You may be in over your head...but you know you can count on your companions.

name: Bonds of Friendship
desc: Were it not for the timely arrival of your companions, all would be lost. But now you must regain your strength. Believe in your friends.

name: The Holy Emperor
desc: Ilia and Tilith have merged their powers, opening a route to strike down Karna Masta. The Summoner pours everything they have into the final battle!

name: Final Seal
desc: The Holy Emperor's physical form has been annihilated. However, two seals remain. As the Summoner searches for the secret, who should appear but...

name: Sealed Soul
desc: The Summoners arrive in Mildran, where Karna Masta's soul is imprisoned. Who could be waiting for them in these lands?

name: Luxurious Ruins
desc: Mildran, the former home of great royalty. The ruins still visible in the thin fog remind you of those long-gone days of luxury.

name: Rejecting Seal
desc: There are those who came to this place of their own will, to face the past. But the "Rejecting Seal" gives them second thoughts.

name: Conquer the Ashes
desc: Amidst the falling ash, you eventually reach something like a town center. Many months and years of history lay in ruins all around you.

name: Wanderer in the Ruins
desc: Wordlessly you progress through the lonely scene. What areas of this capital would most interest Paris if she were here?

name: Misdeeds Draw Near
desc: As you progress through the capital, Ark's demeanor seems to grow more serious. Perhaps he senses something waiting ahead.

name: Resolve and Right
desc: Waiting in the floating castle was a black mass of residual energy and the wandering souls of heroes. Ark steps forward alone for this fated battle!

name: Six Heroes' Will
desc: Ark has reconfirmed his strength after defeating the Six Heroes. Along with the Summoner, he moves forward towards his goal anew.

name: Where Souls Slumber
desc: The story of a hero toyed with by the gods to bring back a loved one. In the end will he find hope, or despair...?

name: Wandering Hermit
desc: With Karna Masta totally defeated, Ark is free to be with Ilia, now released from her seal. Yet, his worries haven't dissipated...

name: Inferno Gate
desc: Welcome to the newly discovered realm of Cordelica. A huge gate towers above you, as if it were beckoning Summoners inside...

name: Cave-Dwelling Assassins
desc: Beyond the huge gate unfolds a fiery cave. It doesn’t look like you’ll find anything worthy of investigation here, so keep moving forward.

name: The Bandits’ Feast
desc: You’ve stumbled into a thriving monster habitat. Judging by the hungry glint in their eyes, you’re probably the first human they’ve seen in centuries.

name: Hot Gale’s Caress
desc: There’s no respite from the scalding heat. A gust of hot wind blasting through the maze of caverns.

name: Before the Flame Princess
desc: A cold wind dries the sweat from your forehead. Could the exit be nearby? You spot a shaft of light, but it’s guarded by a formidable-looking foe...

name: The Foot of the Rainbow
desc: You exit the infernal cave and come upon a huge waterfall spanned by a breathtaking rainbow. Finally, some beautiful scenery to soothe your weary soul.

name: Beneath the Cascade
desc: A monster ambush interrupts your reverie with the scenery. Dispose of them and continue with your investigation.

name: Behind the Waterfall
desc: You pass behind the cascading waterfall and continue to the next area. Lugina’s warning plays in your mind, but you’re too curious to turn back now.

name: An Invisible Presence
