name: The Encounter
desc: You've arrived in Valhalla, a legendary haven for the souls of fallen warriors... The Corruption pervading Elgaia appears to emanate from here. An immense forest stand in front of you.

name: Corrupted Undergrowth
desc: The forest gets more dense around you, radiating an abnormal sense of aggression. You’re not welcome here!

name: Kingdom of Plants
desc: Penetrating into the midst of the forest, you feel a great power all around you. You know that a Valkyrie haunts these woods, but why would she try to fight you?

name: Warrior Queen of the Woods
desc: You have passed the heart of the forest, it should be easier going now. But the evil pervading the woods is still present. You have a growing sense of disquiet.

name: Goddess of Nature
desc: Surrounded by blades of rock and wood, the way ahead is blocked by the mistress of this place. Her aura is no longer the same as when you last encountered her...

name: Bird of Ill Omen
desc: You win! After the forest, the path winds its way up towards the peak. You see only bare rock and carrion birds around you, and death and black magic loom oppressively in the air...

name: Reaper of Shadows
desc: This place, once a haven for vanquished chiefs, generals and sorcerers is nothing but a den of corrupted monsters now.

name: Wings of Desolation
desc: You have mounted as far as the carrion rock. Grief and insanity permeate the rocks of this place. You glimpse images of an ancient tragedy, a forbidden ritual.

name: Carrion Rock
desc: Ancient memories which are not your own overwhelm you. Infinite suffering lingers here, the mistress of this place devouring her sister’s heart.

name: Goddess of the Crows
desc: More and more carrion fowl mass around you, so numerous that they prevent you from moving forward. A potent mix of power and madness assails you from all sides!

name: Electric Shock
desc: The jagged peak drops behind, and now before you lie mountains, lit up by forks of lightning. The place looks perilous, because there is more Corruption here than you thought!

name: Angel of the Summit
desc: Thunder rumbles as you approach, but that isn’t what worries you. You sense that part of this land is under the control of the Corruption!

name: Hammer Blow
desc: Thrud is here. She has always fought on the front lines, and now she’s been corrupted, it’s even more the case.

name: Thunder Hammer
desc: The Valkyrie thunder maiden has spent her life selecting only the boldest of warriors to lead to their rest. The bravest of them all, now fallen and corrupt, stands before you.

name: Goddess of Thunder
desc: Thunder strikes the ground all around you. The mistress of this place will not go down without a fight!

name: Trial by Water
desc: Leaving the mountains behind, you find yourself crossing a wide riverbed. This resting place of the sailors and warriors who’ve died at sea is only a shadow of its former self.

name: The Sea Wyrm
desc: You arrive in front of an immense door which bars the river. You have to cut your way through the bodies of those laid low by the Corruption.

name: The Underwater Grotto
desc: You enter a cavernous grotto, where the water is shallower, but you sense a hostile force coursing through the place!

name: Creatures from the Abyss
desc: Suddenly you no longer know if you are in a cavern or at the bottom of an abyss. No time to ask questions, the corrupted creatures from the abyss are surrounding you.

name: The Trident Goddess
desc: Water, water, everywhere, and yet, you perceive the exit isn’t far off! When you finally drag yourself out of the water, four corrupted tentacles emerge from the depths behind you.

name: Out of the Depths
desc: Having defeated the Valkyrie, you gaze behind you at the gigantic mountain that you crossed. The path before you leads up a snow-covered mountain, bathed in a soft light.

name: A Snowy Path
desc: You trudge forward, the snow slowing your progress. The Corruption is everywhere, and the surroundings deserted. Only the few creatures you find in your path seem to be able to survive here.

name: Sacred Claws
desc: You come to a large building, bathed in light. The Corruption has found its way here too.

name: The Temple of Light
desc: The temple seems completely deserted. But you soon see this isn’t the case. The Corruption no longer needs shadows to hide its presence.

name: Lost Beauty
desc: You pass into a large chamber. The hall is finely sculpted, and you see that here beauty and grace were once held in the same esteem as strength.

name: The Wings of Victory
desc: This place of grace and beauty has been invaded by the Corruption. Unease overwhelms you at last, as you are assailed by a question that your mind has striven to hold back...

name: The Goddess of the Heavens
desc: Alvitr, corrupted just like her sisters were, rises up before you. Then you see the sadness in her face, the same way her sisters looked.

name: Path through the Heavens
desc: One more Valkyrie is vanquished. Your earlier victories taste like ashes in your mouth...

name: The Questions Begin
desc: You no longer concentrate on what you are doing. While you automatically mow down the corrupted, your mind is elsewhere... If the Valkyries are here...if Yggdrasil is corrupted...

name: The Path of Doubt
desc: The plumes of smoke spiralling up from the lava flow are getting thicker. You pay no attention. Your acts are necessary here, the Corruption MUST NOT invade and destroy Grand Gaia... but...

name: The Temple of Lava
desc: You are lost in memories, just like when you visited Geirdriful’s home.

name: The Scarlet Door
desc: Skalmold’s life passes before your eyes. Sacred duties, a feeling of being trapped, seduction, power, solitude, tragedy. Then, when it is at an end, you are plunged into infinite sadness.

name: The Temple Summit
desc: The heat is intense. Finally you catch sight of Yggdrasil in the distance and you understand. If Yggdrasil itself is corrupted, then life itself is corrupted, and not only in the afterlife.

name: Treacherous Flames
desc: You prepare yourself, for you will soon meet Skalmold for the last time. But what will happen to the fallen warriors once the last of the Valkyries is defeated?

name: The Way to the Tree
desc: You are close to the core of this world. Yggdrasil is at the heart of everything here. Its branches reach into infinity, and its roots wind endlessly. Here all worlds are connected.

name: At the Foot of the Tree of Life
desc: The closer you get to the tree, the more its power fills the air. Here you are, at the foot of Yggdrasil, the world tree!

name: The Gateway to all Worlds
desc: The Corruption is everywhere, and is now visible to the naked eye. Every second, each pulse of Yggdrasil’s sap spreads the Corruption through every form of life.

name: Corrupted Roots
desc: The Empty Afterlife. All life is threatened. You head towards the source of the evil and the source of life.

name: Withered Bark
desc: Corrupt creatures launch a coordinated attack. You leave your worries to one side for the moment.

name: Doubt
desc: The Corruption comes from Yggdrasil itself. Finally you know what you have to do here.

name: Light and Shade
desc: Sparing Yggdrasil would condemn all worlds to the Corruption. Bringing it and its avatar down... Would that put an end to existence itself?

name: Yggdrasil
desc: I am become death, The Destroyer of Worlds

name: The Valkyries’ challenge
desc: After Yggdrasil is defeated, the doors of this temple will open. Everything seems peaceful inside. The guardians await you for one final challenge.

name: Help Llewxam Lv. 1
desc: You’ve decided to help Llewxam battle the Corruption.

name: Help Llewxam Lv. 2
desc: Fight the Corruption and suppress her power!

name: Help the Corruption Lv. 1
desc: You’ve decided to help the Corruption spread to Llewxam's portal.
dungeon: Summoners vs Llewxam Weaver of F

name: Help the Corruption Lv. 2
desc: Fight Llewxam and collect her tears!
dungeon: Summoners vs Llewxam Weaver of F

name: Kyo's Training Grounds Lv. 1
desc: Kyo Kusanagi, renowned for his impressive mastery of Pyrokinesis, will gladly train you and unleash your potential. But first, you'll have to show him what you're capable of!

name: Kyo's Training Grounds Lv. 2
desc: Rare are those who become well versed in the Kusanagi style of ancient martial arts. Your dedication is admirable, but Kyo will not make this any easier for you. Keep it up!

name: Kyo's Training Grounds Lv. 3
desc: The Scion of the Flame recognizes your valor. As a terrifying foe named Rugal slowly claims dominion over Grand Gaia, Kyo is confident you will be ready to stop him.

name: Rugal's Operating Base Lv. 1
desc: Equally as cruel as he is powerful, Rugal Bernstein came to Grand Gaia with the darkest of intentions, meeting no resistance. Halt his plans before he sets them all in motion!

name: Rugal's Operating Base Lv. 2
desc: You've proven to be a worthy opponent for which Rugal will show no mercy. Do not underestimate his ease to learn your moves or you will become yet another one of his trophies!

name: Rugal's Operating Base Lv. 3
desc: Rugal's fury has escalated tenfold, unleashing a state he cannot hold for too long. Send this false god back to the portal whence he came before we face total annihilation!

name: First expedition
desc: Journal excerpt: "...closed shut behind me, I am drifting towards the unknown, powerless." Obtain the Valkyrie Spirit material in this expedition!

name: Second Expedition
desc: Journal excerpt: "...like a distant memory. Am I also lost in time? Mysterious figures rise before me. Men or Beasts, I can't decide!" Obtain the Noblesse Emblem material in this expedition!

name: Third Expedition
desc: Journal excerpt: "...since this new passage opened. How these knights's armors shine is still beyond me! What unknown energy could..." Obtain the Photon Bot material in this expedition!

name: Special expedition
desc: Journal excerpt: "...snow everywhere..." "...this world seems safer..." "...a strange feeling... hap... happiness..."

name: Fourth Expedition
desc: Journal Excerpt: “... Another new world. Nothing’s moving. Does anyone live here? What is this dust in the distance?” Obtain Damaged Techs in this expedition!

name: Fifth expedition
desc: Journal excerpt: "…Where am I? This world seems hostile… This energy…" Obtain the Dragon's scale material in this expedition!

name: Family Feud
desc: Join Heinrich and his protégé, Amadeus, as they step inside Cornelius's fighting pits. Their minds were already set before entering his tournament: today, the tyrant falls!

name: The End is the Beginning
desc: Ninmah uses quite a mysterious power to travel through time. Why? To assess what her progeny will bring to the world, and to make a difficult choice!

name: Where does Love lead?
desc: Arthur has but one goal: to bring Viviane back to life. In order to do this, he has found a powerful ally: Lancelot. But how far will he go in order to bring back his beloved?

name: The benefactor of winter
desc: Dear Prince, would you kindly help me to bring the snow in my country? It's always too hot... And snow is so beautiful! It shines!

name: The Suspicious Village
desc: Jake’s desire for ruin allowed him to become the right-hand man of Coal Cauldron. He’s sent to investigate who might be connected with the rebel Blink in this village: a decisive mission.

name: Last Chance
desc: Iaroslava still hasn't joined a squad as the deadline approaches quickly. However, it just happens that Team C is looking for one last member...

name: The Lone Huntress
desc: While Iaroslava has been part of Team C for a while, everything is not going as she had hoped.

name: Graveyard of Souls
desc: Strange beings lurking in the darkest corners of this graveyard... Some believe their powers are there for the taking! Play this Dungeon and you may win powerful Units!

name: A turbulent arrival
desc: 20 years after Arthur's death, an anomaly amongst certain robots has begun to threaten the Kingdom. Accompanied by the young and loyal Lancelot, King Perceval sets off on his quest.

name: Alone in battle
desc: Perceval and Lancelot have become separated during the struggle and now Lancelot is surrounded by a group of particularly aggressive robots.

name: Royal clashes
desc: Still apart, Perceval is getting closer and closer to the robot troops, which seem to constantly be increasing in number.

name: The robot troops
desc: Perceval and Lancelot are both making progress. Perceval is trying to locate the mastermind behind the robots; however, the area appeared barren. He will be quick to move on.

name: Alone in the sandstorm
desc: Lancelot is very close to King Perceval, but he is now at the heart of the robot army. The enemies are increasing in numbers, making it difficult to advance.

name: At the heart of the robot army
desc: Perceval and Lancelot finally managed to reunite. Now they need to find and neutralize the mastermind behind the rebellion in order to stop the robot troops.

name: Robot revelation
desc: There are more mechanical troops than ever. It would appear that their leader is not too far away.

name: The Damaged Robot
desc: Galahad had been greatly damaged during the fighting. Perceval decides to bring him with them. Time to make a decision on what to do.

name: The Lakes Region
desc: The path of the Technology Center goes through the Lakes Region, a region that is normally quite calm.

name: Robotic Wanderings
desc: The monsters are as aggressive as ever, increasing in number. The advance will not be as easy as anticipated.

name: An Unexpected Arrival
desc: The road to the Technology Center is long. If the monsters continue to slow down Perceval and Lancelot, there isn't much chance Galahad will be fixable anymore.

name: Sea Monsters
desc: Viviane will examine Galahad, but she needs time and, moreover, not to be disturbed. It will be necessary to repel the monsters, which continue to increase in number!

name: Repair and revelation
desc: Viviane has been examining Galahad for some time already. The monsters do not seem to want to leave you alone.

name: The Deep Memory
desc: It seems the mystery surrounding Galahad's behavior may yet be solved. Viviane only needs a bit more time.

name: The Encounter
desc: Galahad’s Recording 01: Arthur learned that the demons' activity in the region had been increasing for some time. He thus decided to head to their lair to investigate.

name: The Quest
desc: Galahad’s Recording 02: Arthur continued to advance through the demonic lair, looking for answers to his questions.

name: Tracking
desc: Galahad’s Recording 03: After some searching, the demon that had pursued Arthur was detected once again. Arthur then continued tracking in this direction.

name: Doubt
desc: Galahad’s Recording 04: Confused by the demon’s words, Arthur asked many questions. Still, he continued his quest for answers.

name: The Decision
desc: Galahad’s Recording 05: Arthur calmed down. His determination allowed him to continue on his journey. He was ready to fight the demon.

name: Destiny
desc: Galahad’s Recording 06: The choice is made. It is too late to turn back. Arthur’s destiny awaited him.

name: The Clash
desc: Galahad’s Recording 07: The clash between Arthur and the demon is now inevitable.

name: New Mission
desc: Perceval realizes the danger that the demon in Galahad's memories represents. He thus entrusts Lancelot with a new mission.

name: Separation
desc: Perceval and Viviane return to Neo Avalon in order to organize the town's defenses. Meanwhile, Lancelot heads for the forest, where Merlin should be.

name: Strange Mountains
desc: Lancelot hears a strange voice call out to him. Who could it be...?

name: An Unsettling Voice
desc: The voice does not stop. However, Lancelot ignores it and continues to advance. The stakes of his mission are way too high.

name: Memories
desc: This encounter with Mordred's ghost troubles Lancelot. Memories of events from the rebellion against Arthur flood his mind.

name: The Ghost
desc: Lancelot continues along the path towards the forest. He gets ready for his next encounter with the chimera.

name: Past
desc: The edge of the forest is now visible. Lancelot knows what awaits him, and he prepares to fight.

name: A Path
desc: Lancelot finally arrives at the forest Viviane mentioned, but it is infested with monsters. The path onward looks arduous.

name: Espionage
desc: Lancelot heads towards the voices that emanate from the depths of the forest, hoping to find Merlin and quickly fulfill his mission.

name: Demon
desc: The voices emanating from the forest are now very close to Lancelot. He approaches carefully in order to not be spotted.

name: Pursuit
desc: Lancelot finally found Merlin, but he seems to be co-operating with the demon. What is this plan Merlin is speaking about?

name: Depths of the Forest
desc: Merlin takes flight and progresses further into the forest. For the sake of his mission and his kingdom, Lancelot swiftly pursues him.

name: Motivation
desc: More determined than ever, Lancelot continues to follow Merlin. A strange feeling suddenly takes over the intrepid soldier.

name: Revelation
desc: Lancelot understands then that, in reality, Merlin was testing him. He is now ready to pass this final test.

name: Town Under Siege
desc: Merlin and Lancelot return to Neo Avalon in order to find Perceval and Viviane. Upon their arrival, the town is besieged by a horde of demons.

name: Concerns
desc: Anxious yet supported by Lancelot, Merlin manages to make a break through the waves of demonic creatures. Will they be able to reach the palace in time?

name: The Wizard’s Plan
desc: Merlin and Lancelot reached the palace. Their abilities will be tested once again. So, what is this hope that the powerful wizard had alluded to…?

name: Save the Past
desc: Merlin finished charging the armor with the power of the Grail. By activating it, will Viviane reach her destination? Will she be able to change the past?

name: Searching for the King
desc: Viviane succeeded in returning to the past. She must hurry in order to find and save the bearer of Excalibur.

name: Time is Running Out
desc: Although she is making progress, the time traveler worries that she will not arrive in time. Nevertheless, her sensors go off…

name: Change the Past
desc: Viviane catches up with Arthur and Mordred, who are entangled in a fierce battle without mercy. Will she succeed in protecting the King from the fatal wound that is destined for him?

name: A New Continuity
desc: Viviane believed that she failed her mission; however, Merlin’s plan was more complex. There is another Excalibur user to save…

name: A New Menace
desc: Mordred has become King and the kingdom prospers. Nevertheless, he has increased the region’s military presence due to Viviane’s warnings. The menace she spoke of seems to be very close...

name: A Cry for Help
desc: Viviane hurries towards the forest where Merlin is. According to Viviane, he holds the key that will allow them to vanquish Enquibedes.

name: The Demon Hunt
desc: Meanwhile, Gwenevere detects Enquibedes’ presence. Accompanied by Lancelot, she chases after him.

name: The Path of Vengeance
desc: Gwenevere and Lancelot continue on their path towards the Demon. Their route is scattered with demons. However, Gwenevere’s motivation will not yield for something so trivial.

name: Reunion
desc: Gwenevere and Lancelot finally arrive at the battlefield where Mordred’s forces clash with the demon horde. Gwenevere becomes riled up at thought of finding Enquibedes.

name: Race Against Time
desc: Viviane and Merlin return to the battlefield with a plan to defeat the Demon.

name: Fateful Clash
desc: Mordred, Merlin, and Viviane go back into combat against Enquibedes. They find Gwenevere and Lancelot already embedded in battle with the Demon.

name: Rupture of the Pact Lv. 1
desc: Viviane’s temporal shift was not without consequence. The Pact that Morgana had made with Enquibedes was corrupted.

name: Rupture of the Pact Lv. 2
desc: Viviane’s temporal shift was not without consequence. The Pact that Morgana had made with Enquibedes was corrupted.

name: Romantic Stroll Lv. 1
desc: There's a strange atmosphere in this place. A test awaits you…

name: Romantic Stroll Lv. 2
desc: A mysterious knight wants to test you again. But, what is he up to?

name: Romantic Stroll Lv. 3
desc: The knight awaits you for one final confrontation… Are you up to the challenge?

name: Burning Electrocution
desc: Learn to harness the power of Fire and Thunder with a sparring match versus Mai and Benimaru! Are you ready for this?

name: Granite Undertow
desc: Learn to harness the forces of Water and Earth with a sparring match against Kula and Terry! Are you going to be okay?

name: Scintillating Darkness
desc: Learn to harness the energy of Light and Dark with a sparring match against Athena and Iori! Care to wager on your odds?

name: Two Enter, Only One Leaves
desc: Time to put your skills on the line in a royal rumble fit for legends! Embrace the elements and let them guide you to victory!

name: Tech Hunting
desc: Coal Cauldron’s band has taken power. However, the rebels seek to liberate the Bad Lands. Two of them, Plumatachi and Sesir, are sent to find Techs in the desert.

name: Unexpected Obstacles
desc: The mutants continue to increase in number and a sandstorm picks up. Perhaps the mission will not be as easy as expected.

name: Cry for Help
desc: The Techs are very close now. The only obstacle between Plumatachi, Sesir and their goal is the number of mutants.

name: City Under Siege
desc: Plumatachi, Sesir, and Jake returned to the town of the rebellion. At the town’s entrance, some of Coal Cauldron’s men block their path.

name: Despair
desc: The group succeeded in getting around most of Coal Cauldron’s troops, who were too occupied with pillaging the warehouses. They now arrive at the center of the town.

name: The General
desc: None of Coal Cauldron’s troops have left the rebel city. A General stands in the middle of the street. He appears to be very strong.

name: A Strange Cemetery
desc: Sesir guides Plumatachi and Jake through a strange area. Rumors say that one of Coal Cauldron’s allies is located somewhere here.

name: A Lone Path
desc: With a heavy heart, Plumatachi continues to walk alone through the cemetery.

name: On Track
desc: Jake and Sesir go to look for Plumatachi. The sky becomes clouded and rain starts to fall.

name: The Encounter
desc: Plumatachi becomes lost in the cemetery. However, she is far too determined to reach her goal to stop here.

name: Trust
desc: Gazolina guides Plumatachi to the cemetery exit to find their two companions. They prepare for the attack on their next target.

name: Cursed Wreckage
desc: Strange voices and lights emanate from the ship graveyard. It is said that if anyone goes there at midnight, they will come across something terribly frightful.

name: The Sky King
desc: The group guided by Gazolina arrives at the lair of Crash Belt, one of Coal Cauldron’s generals.

name: An Explosive Plan
desc: Plumatachi and her group continue onward through what seems to be an immense landfill. All sorts of vehicles from ancient times are scattered throughout.

name: The Landfill
desc: Following Jake’s plan, the group heads for the place he indicated.

name: Sabotage
desc: Jake starts to plant explosives by the generator. The group must protect him while he finishes up.

name: The First General
desc: Plumatachi finally finds herself before Crash Belt. She shivers with anticipation at the idea of killing him.

name: The Arms Dealer
desc: A smuggler had been using the generator’s energy in order to create Techs that he sold to the highest bidder. He will not let you go without making you pay for his losses.

name: The Tribal Festival
desc: The group arrives at a large plain where a tribal festival is taking place. The sound makes the ground vibrate for kilometers around.

name: Unexpected Encounter
desc: While the group becomes drawn into the tribal festival, they hear sounds of combat emanating from not far off.

name: The Newcomer
desc: Plumatachi went ahead and the rest of the group now tries to rejoin her. However, Voodoo’s men seem not to want to let them advance.

name: Mud and Mutants
desc: The group has still not caught up with Plumatachi. They continue to move through the tribal festival, surrounded by Voodoo’s troops.

name: A Sad Ending
desc: Finally, the center of the festival. The music is stronger here than anywhere else. Everything vibrates from the power of the bass.

name: Separation
desc: Jake is on the ground, not moving... However, Plumatachi doesn’t change her mind. She wants to eliminate Voodoo.

name: A Disturbing Silence
desc: The music stops. In this silence, your group makes too much noise and is quickly noticed. One mutant in particular seems to not want you to leave.

name: The Mission Continues
desc: Sesir has left the group, but this doesn’t shake Plumatachi’s unwavering drive. Accompanied by Natalamé and Gazolina, she arrives at Pig Bull’s fort.

name: The First Warlord
desc: The group continues to infiltrate the fort, destroying one by one the waves of henchmen that Pig Bull assembles in their path.

name: Infiltration
desc: Natalamé goes ahead, alone, in order to find Pig Bull. The henchmen in her path don't seem to pose much of a thread to her.

name: Sinister Fortress
desc: Plumatachi and Gazolina continue along their path, but they don’t find any trace of the famous Warlord.

name: Lies
desc: Plumatachi and Gazolina soon arrive at Pig Bull’s lair. The showdown is inevitable.

name: The Two Generals
desc: While exploring the fort, you come across Pig Bull’s two most powerful henchmen. They don't seem to want to let you leave.

name: Invaders
desc: Pig Bull recounts what actually happened during Coal Cauldron’s attack on Blink’s fortress.

name: The Tyrant
desc: Blink and Natalamé continue to push back waves of henchmen in order to allow the survivors time to escape. However, it seemed that Coal Cauldron himself was about to arrive.

name: Escape
desc: Coal Cauldron’s forces are too powerful and great in size. Blink decides to retreat. She and Natalamé retreat towards their village.

name: Massacre
desc: Finally arriving at the village, Natalamé and Blink discover that Coal has sent his troops after them. Having nowhere to hide, fighting is their last resort.

name: Truth
desc: Natalamé can no longer stand Blink’s way of doing things. She prepares herself to do what she knows best… Kill.

name: Moving Forward
desc: Following her wrongdoings, Natalamé went looking for Coal Cauldron and her generals to kill them. Unfortunately, she could only find the rearguard..

name: Betrayal
desc: Plumatachi thus learns the truth directly from Pig Bull. A new target has just been added to her list.

name: Pursuit
desc: Pig Bull is now dead, but this is of little importance to Plumatachi. She pursues her new target, who is headed towards Coal Cauldron’s fortress.

name: Infernal Heat
desc: The two warriors progress through the fortress, destroying the waves of henchmen in their path.

name: Despot
desc: The number of henchmen only increases. The tyrant isn’t much further away. Plumatachi no longer responds to reason. Blinded by rage, she shoots at anything that moves.

name: For Blink!
desc: Coal Cauldron is no more. Blink’s assassin stands before Plumatachi. The latter trembles with excitement at the thought of exacting her vengeance.

name: Last Victim
desc: Plumatachi’s vengeance is complete. However, one person who helped Coal Cauldron in the past still remains and Plumatachi intends to finish what she started.

name: An ordinary day at gumi Europe
desc: Infiltrate gumi Europe and defeat Elie, the mighty English Community Manager to discover the latest news and secrets of Brave Frontier RPG.

name: Elie & Friends UNLEASHED!
desc: Frustrated that they can't make bad jokes every day, Elie and friends set out on a rampage to create chaos. MWAHAH- oh please somebody help us!! please! - gimu

name: Isle of Evolution
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of evolution!

name: Isle of Experience
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of experience!

name: Isle of Wealth
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of wealth!

name: Isle of Knowledge
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of knowledge!

name: Isle of Growth
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of growth!

name: Power Island
desc: In this temporarily stabilized part of the Rift, one can find the power of shards!

name: Anomaly
desc: Sedrac dedicates his life to researching and analyzing different Rifts. Lately, however, he’s observed some strange phenomena… What could be the cause of all this?

name: A Familiar Face
desc: Sedrac and Alvitr arrive in Valhalla and quickly find the other Valkyries present: Eir, Thrud, Svafa, and their queen Freyja. Valhalla seems to be plunged into chaos.

name: Return of the Missing People
desc: Sedrac and Eir go to the east in order to push back the invaders. Along the path, they meet up with some individuals who should not be there...

name: A Strange Machine
desc: Sedrac tells Freyja the news. The queen has her group fight the invaders in that area and she joins up with Sedrac’s unit.

name: The Champion's Challenge
desc: Surt, the god of fire, is challenging you. Prove you're worthy of the title of Hero in the world of Valkyries.

name: Return Home
desc: Sedrac and Aymarks arrive in the Mirror World. Unfortunately, times are not calm. The problems that the Valkyries faced appear to be present here as well.

name: Amnesia
desc: Sedrac and his group seek out Magena’s attacker while Tuanregguj accompanies the group for safety. Might fate grant him the chance for redemption?

name: Recovered Memories
desc: Auhlavez is finally free, but Aymarks notices that Sedrac seems a little off. Nevertheless, another metallic structure is in sight and there’s no doubt that powerful guardians will be there.

name: Champion’s Challenge
desc: Auhlavez, Master of Wisdom, challenges you. Prove yourself worthy as a hero of the Mirror World.

name: The Warrior’s Rage
desc: After returning Magena to her world, Sedrac remained in the mirror world. He stayed in contact in order to provide her with guidance so she could save her world.

name: Parents and Children
desc: Once Plumatachi returned to her world, Sedrac reconnected with Magena’s group. Sedrac had again detected an immense source of power...

name: Past and Future
desc: Gilgamesh, now in charge, guides the team of Shapeshifters towards the machine. However, Ninmah doesn’t seem glad to see her father again...

name: The Champion’s Challenge
desc: Gilgamesh, emperor from the past, challenges you. Show yourself worthy to be a hero of the world of Shapeshifters.

name: Meanwhile
desc: While Sedrac finishes resolving the situation with the Shape-shifters, the Warlord Coal Cauldron opens his eyes and discovers he

name: Couple(s)
desc: Sedrac managed to find a group of travelers who might be more receptive. However, he is interrupted by a poignant reunion.

name: Goodbye
desc: Sedrac guides the group of women, now bolstered by the presence of Sheriff and Cobalt. All that remains is to destroy the infamous machine, but is trust strong enough?

name: Champion’s Challenge
desc: Sheriff, protector of the innocent, challenges you. Prove yourself worthy of being a hero of the world of Bad Lands.

name: Where is she?
desc: After saving the Bad Lands, Sedrac tried to renew contact with Viviane. Receive no reply, he decided to go visit the young woman’s world.

name: Kings and a Queen
desc: The Lancelot from alternative Arthur's world has joined the group. Will Sedrac be able to convince him to cooperate?

name: On Two Fronts
desc: A strategy is devised. The metallic structure will be attacked on two fronts. Will Sedrac manage to save this world without mishap?

name: Champion’s Challenge
desc: Utheria, undefeated champion, challenges you. Show yourself worthy of being a hero of the world of Neo Avalon.

name: Captured and Saved
desc: Viviane tells Sedrac what happened after her departure from the Bad Lands.

name: Heroes and the Herald
desc: Sedrac and Viviane move through the Rift in order to reach an unknown area. Their journey is not without peril...

name: Back to the Roots
desc: After destroying Yggdrasil, Sedrac decides to leave in order to search for heroes from each world while Viviane leads the troops at the frontlines.

name: Champion’s Challenge
desc: Ophiuchus, zodiacal champion, challenges you. Prove yourself worthy of being a hero of the constellations.

name: Mirror’s Reflection
desc: Sedrac and the Apex have arrived in the enemy’s stronghold. It is located in a secret area of the Rift. However, needless to say, the path is fraught with peril.

name: Goddess of the Trinity
desc: The final battle approaches! Sedrac will finally find out who is hiding behind this voice...

name: Paternal Support
desc: When all seems lost, hope returns when an ally intervenes. Will this be enough to stop the Goddess of the Trinity?

name: Goddess’s Challenge
desc: Htilit, Goddess of the Trinity, defies you. Prove yourself worthy of being a hero capable of saving the universe.

name: The final stronghold
desc: While peace reigned in the tiny village of Domrémy, forces from the sea prepared to attack. A new invasion begins...

name: Hunt in the forest
desc: Some Shapeshifters attack the village, while others chase the villagers who have run away into the forest. They were not expecting to encounter any resistance...

name: Strange young girl
desc: Amadeus and Heinrich arrive in the village mentioned by the villager girl. All that is left to do is to find the famous young girl.

name: Counterattack
desc: The attack on the village has been interrupted. The group now launches an offensive in order to push back the invaders.

name: Marine monster
desc: Village folk stories speak of a creature who lives in the depths near the village. Some strange noises have been heard recently... Perhaps the stories are true...?

name: Don’t Leave Anyone Behind!
desc: By the shore, Heinrich, Amadeus, and Jeanne chase the last Shapeshifters that are trying to escape. In their flight, they leave behind a strange clue.

name: On Cornelius’ Trail
desc: Once they find a map, the hunters set off for an unknown island where Cornelius was.

name: Purification of the Island
desc: The hunters decide to separate into two groups in order to wipe out all the Shapeshifters on the island.

name: The End of an Era
desc: Once reunited, the group heads to the west of the island in order to finish the total purification.

name: The Master of Animals
desc: The hunters located the Shapeshifter who tried to attack Hamilincourt. She appears ready for anything. This fight does not seem easy.

name: Dark Omen
desc: Just as Robespierre, a politician known throughout Hamelincourt, decides to visit the town square, he suddenly has a vision.

name: New Determination
desc: After his vision, Robespierre continues on his way to confront Condorcet.

name: Inflamed Situation
desc: When Robespierre fights Condorcet, their battle is interrupted by the Hamelincourt guards.

name: Hamelincourt Uprising
desc: After freeing the prisoners, Robespierre decides to go up against the Hamelincourt captain.

name: Widespread Rumor
desc: On the way to Lutèce, the hunters meet up with some Shapeshifters who caught wind of the Hamelincourt rebellion.

name: A Dangerous Path
desc: The group moves towards the capital, Lutèce, now that Robespierre has joined them.

name: Change of Plans
desc: While Robespierre runs to the aid of the villagers, the rest of the group tries to catch up with him.

name: The Master and the Student
desc: Separated now from the rest of the group, Heinrich and Amadeus take care of eliminating the Shapeshifters located in the South of the village.

name: Trap and Plot
desc: Each pair having completed its task, they all regroup at the village’s exit.

name: Rumor from the Forest
desc: Rumor has it that a terrible creature roams the forests surrounding Lutèce. Could it be a Shapeshifter?

name: Power of Knowledge
desc: The group of hunters finally arrives at the capital of Lutèce. But unfortunately, the city is being attacked by Shapeshifters.

name: Presidential Rescue
desc: After running into Emily, the group finally reaches the palace. There’s a stronger Shapeshifter presence here... The President is surely in danger.

name: The Beginning of Change
desc: Heinrich received the support that he needed, but he leaves the group in order to find an informer in the forest. The role of group leader is therefore left to Robespierre.

name: The Revolution
desc: Robespierre, accompanied by Emily and Jeanne, infiltrates the Lutèce Palace. The revolution is unfolding...

name: The Loyal Knights
desc: Robespierre has now taken control. However, the most faithful knights of the former president disagree with this change...

name: A Winding Forest
desc: While Robespierre takes power in Lutèce, Heinrich heads towards his rendez-vous point. However, the journey onward promises to be difficult…

name: His Own Path
desc: Unable to bear watching his master set out on what could be a trap, Amadeus rushes after Heinrich.

name: Revelation
desc: Amadeus approaches the rendez-vous point. Heinrich seems to already be at the location when Amadeus catches bits of a conversation…

name: Clash of Horns
desc: As the Lavinias take their last breath, Amadeus thinks he’s finally done with fighting. Then, suddenly, a strange man arrives at their location…

name: The Depths of the Forest
desc: The majority of wild animals avoid certain areas of the forest. Could powerful predators be located there?

name: Dirty Work
desc: It’s been several months since Robespierre came to power, yet some people still refuse to recognize him as ruler. He therefore sends his most faithful soldier to take care of the problem...

name: Shameful Secret
desc: Jeanne and Emily heard that a village had been attacked and they arrive there, before Admiral Nelson. The female hunters then discover the Admiral’s true motives.

name: Last Hope
desc: Jeanne and Emily managed to convince Nelson to join them and they set off again for the capital in order to put an end to Robespierre’s terror.

name: Déjà Vu
desc: Jeanne, Emily, and Nelson arrive in the capital and head directly to the palace with a sense of déjà vu. The final clash against Robespierre is drawing near.

name: Ancient Mystery
desc: Emily had read that an ancient system of pathways exists in the sewers, but no one has ever dared to try it out.

name: A New Future
desc: The fight for internal power in the Republic is now over. However, in the floating kingdom, Cornelius prepares to use his new weapon: Cosette.

name: Revenge is a Dish That’s Best Served...
desc: Dream World - After Cornelius’ training, Cosette has now reached an immense level of power. A level much higher than that of Cornelius...

name: History Class
desc: Welcome to Grand Gaia School, the most renowned institute in the world. On your schedule, you see that you begin with History class...

name: Recess
desc: After this first captivating class, you head to the playground. Along the way, someone from the school staff stops you.

name: Biology Class
desc: After your encounter, you realize that you just missed recess. You just have one class left: Biology.

name: Homework
desc: Monsters are invading Grand Gaia School. May the strongest students come to its aid!

name: Htilit's Super Spookfest
desc: Take part in the (incredible and scary) Super Spookfest organized by (the generous, beautiful and humble) Htilit, and use your spooky items to craft spooky spheres!

name: Htilit's Frenzy Farmfest
desc: Aha, you've discovered the Spookfest's secret area! If you're brave enough, join us for even more loot! Who knows, maybe you'll get a special rare item in there... Tee-hee-hee!

name: Not a good start...
desc: It's a big day at Siegfried Academy: the second-year students have gone dragon hunting. Natasha has broken away from her group; she's most likely following a fresh lead...

name: Something new for the squad
desc: Two members of the squad have finally found each other. They set off hunting again.

name: Everything for glory
desc: The hunting comes to an end; several squad members have almost found their prey. Who will get to it first?

name: Lack of trust
desc: After their failure, Natasha and Daria decided to skirt around the rules of the Academy in order to obtain points to climb back up the rankings.

name: Welcome to the squad
desc: The three girls continue to follow the trail of their prey. The level of cooperation between Tatiana and the other two members doesn't seem to be all that great...

name: The forbidden hunt
desc: The three girls reach their prey's lair; Tatiana's strength should ensure their victory. But a silhouette is lurking in the shadows...

name: The Punishment
desc: The girls will have to face the consequences of their evening escapade. What does the captain have reserved for them?

name: Back on the Trail
desc: The four girls all have very different personalities and find themselves obliged to cooperate. Will Natasha and Iaroslava make efforts so that everything goes well?

name: More Than Just an Alpha
desc: The dragon's roar seemed very powerful, even for an ancient Alpha. The Captain appears to be very tense. However, an Alpha dragon should not overly concern her…

name: Return to Normalcy
desc: Despite their adventure with the Omega dragon, the girls' daily routines didn't change much at all: class, practicals, stressing out for exams...

name: A Bit More Crowded
desc: Finals week has arrived, along with new anxiety attacks. Especially since the girls have not been allowed to stray from the Academy for awhile.

name: Night Terror
desc: It's the final sprint. The exams are very close and the girls work relentlessly. They fall to sleep late at night, their books in their laps.

name: The Eastern Mountains
desc: The Academy has been badly damaged by the Omegas' attack: the entire west wing has been destroyed and is now uninhabitable. The students have been entrusted with restoring the Academy.

name: Center for Plant Life Studies
desc: The Regional Center for Plant Life Studies of the Eastern Mountains has been abandoned for many years. They carried out research there, aiming to improve the equipment used by hunters.

name: Strange Studies
desc: The last news the Center reported was that they had completed their work and were thus closing their doors. The Academy approved this decision and the Center gradually fell into ruins.

name: The Notebook
desc: The adventure in the laboratory had an unexpected effect: Iaroslava became friends with the rest of the squad. Certain adventures can create bonds you might have thought were unimaginable.

name: Final Lesson
desc: Despite the numerous dragon attacks around the world, lessons continue for the students at the Academy. These students are the hope and future of all hunters-to-be.

name: Last Chance
desc: Following the latest dragon attack, Natasha and the others cannot run away any more and they must face the dragons as a last resort...

name: After the Battle
desc: Defeated by the Omegas, will the heroic attack carried out by Natasha and the others be enough for them to reach the other world?

name: Alone in the Rubble
desc: Months after the destruction of Siegfried Academy, one of its professors explores a city in ruins. The outbreak of dragons makes the survival of humans very difficult.

name: In Search of Provisions
desc: A heavily armed young woman also arrives in the city. Her mission? To find provisions in order to ensure the survival of her group.

name: Not-So-Esteemed Professor...
desc: Hearing roars in the distance, Aleksandra hastens in order to face the last of the dragons in the city.

name: First and Foremost, Protection
desc: The Omega moves closer and closer. Aleksandra will have to put aside her resentment in order to team up with Olga.

name: The Little Girl with Divine Power
desc: During the Convergence, Htilit was vanquished by the Apex. However, it would appear that she survived. She will make the acquaintance of a very special little girl…

name: Change of Heart
desc: Htilit has Lucy travel through time and space. Together, they discover many worlds, but will this be enough to keep the littlegirl entertained?

name: Let the Parade begin!
desc: Our famous presenter, Elie, is exceptionally hosting our Special 2017 Parade. Join us to relive our favorite moments of 2017!

name: Banquet and petits fours
desc: It wouldn't be a worthy Parade without petits fours and other delicious appetizers! Come capture tons of Evolution Units, as well as the 2017 Jewel of Remembrance, in this mission.

name: An Intruder amongst Lovers
desc: Julia gathered all the soul mates of this world inside of the Temple of Love. However, it would appear that an unwanted guest has also joined the couples...

name: Sweet Treats
desc: Chocolates are scattered throughout the Temple of Love! Collect them in order to craft and improve Julia and Sergio character spheres!

name: Fire Wing
desc: Run through fire and lava to get the power of Ignis Shards !

name: Water Wing
desc: You should resist the Blizzard to win the Algor Shards

name: Earth Wing
desc: Can you explore the entire forrest and fing the Terra shards ?

name: Thunder Wing
desc: After fighting storms and lightning, you're about to get the Fulgur Shards

name: Light Wing
desc: You have to overcome the purity of Light to get the Lux Shards

name: Dark Wing
desc: Don't be afraid of darkness, the Umbra Shards are nearly...

name: The Goddess, the Eyebrows, and the Hat
desc: Htilit is yet again in an odd situation... Will she manage to resolve the problem with Elie?

name: Spring Ballad
desc: A light wind arrives to Grand Gaia, swirling Spring Petals around! Collect them to craft the Spring Shard!

name: Spring Blossom
desc: The wind blows harder and even more Spring Petals are flying in the sky! Catch them quickly!

name: The Other World
desc: Natasha and her companions have perished in combat! But it seems that the plan is working as anticipated...

name: Divine Audience
desc: Natasha and her companions are in Valhalla. And they are in the presence of a goddess who appears to know a lot about the dragons...

name: The Origin of the Dragons
desc: Goddess Frigg has a plan. Will the hunters from the Academy be able to execute it?

name: Best Friends
desc: Frigg decides to tell a story about the past, explaining how everything began… But she is interrupted by a familiar face!

name: The First Valkyrie
desc: While Htilit and Lucy are gone, Frigg tells her story. A story about an ancient god of Valhalla…

name: Divine Judgment
desc: Frigg continues her story and reveals the origin of many tragic events…

name: What is the Question?
desc: Some time after the events of the Convergence, Sedrac searches for answers. Like most people, he had forgotten what had happened...

name: Two Opposing Sides
desc: Meanwhile, the world of the Shapeshifters seems to be menaced by some mysterious warriors. An alliance could help, but...

name: The Survivors
desc: Natasha and her team leave for the world of the Academy. A disturbance was felt from Valhalla...

name: Apex Duo
desc: Ragnarok approaches... The alternate realities are also in danger! Will the power of two Apexes be enough?

name: The League of Tyrants

desc: Ragnarok approaches... An alternate version of Crash Belt has managed to assemble individuals from many different worlds, but will he be able to make them a team?

name: Unpardonable
desc: Enquibedes has returned to spread discord! Lucy tries to work things out...

name: A Dangerous Reunion
desc: Another group has joined the coalition, but time is of the essence! The dragons have broken through and are getting close to Iaroslava!

desc: Enquibedes doesn’t seem bothered by dragon Goddess Llewxam’s arrival. Is his plan unerring?

name: All together
desc: The alliance formed by the champions of the worlds within the Rift is facing the imminent Ragnarok. Will they be brave enough to face it?

name: The miracle of friendship
desc: Lucy had an idea, but did she succeed… ?

desc: It would seem that the world created by Lucy abounds with all kinds of wonders…

name: The Forgotten Slave

name: The Forgotten Lovers
desc: You defeated the slave, but two other entities are waiting for you further in the dungeon.

name: The Forgotten

name: A Risky Situation

name: In search of a treatment
desc: Etudrev and Ruetcurtsed start on their way to find help from the fire hero. But they do not know this world and nature is very wild here

name: A powerful enemy

name: Out the Window Lv. 2

name: Sight of Sound Lv. 4
